Mctt.Core.Completeness.Inductives.ViewReadback

The Stuck Eliminator at a View, Read as the Container's

A view's stuck eliminator reads back as its container's (read_ne_elim at im_sel, E1′). The container's stuck eliminator at the wrapped blocks and the group's at the view's member read back alike: block by block over the members of the group read, the blocks they read are the group's own by the agreement of the views' maps (view_maps_coherent), under fresh variables of the container's telescopes on one side and of the group's on the other. Those fresh variables are related at the group's relations: a container's type at its uniform parameters ub is related to the container's at the view's instance cups at the group's uniform parameters, which is related to the group's by the view's equations (ViewEquations.tele_link_types). The recursive results at the positions a view nests through are the eliminators' at members of lower rank.

Fresh Variables of a View's Container and of the Group

The view m of the container's member k' at the instance Is, its map vm; the group's uniform parameters u0, the instance's value cups there, and uniform parameters ub of the container related to cups. The container's member i' and the group's member v the view takes it to. The relations of types linked by a related pair agree.
Lemma rel_link : forall (i j k : universe_index) R T S a b c d, DF a ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> DF b ≈ c ∈ per_univ_elem j ↘ T ->
    DF c ≈ d ∈ per_univ_elem k ↘ S -> (R <~> S).
Proof.
  intros * H1 H2 H3.
  etransitivity; [ exact (per_univ_elem_chain_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1 H2) | exact (per_univ_elem_chain_iff _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H2 H3) ].
Qed.

A fresh variable of a type other than LevelSort is related to one of a related type.
Lemma fresh_var_rel : forall (i : universe_index) R a b s, DF a ≈ b ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R -> not_level_sort a ->
    R (⇑! a s) (⇑! b s).
Proof. intros * H Ha; exact (var_per_elem s H Ha). Qed.

Lemma fresh_tele_cons_inv : forall κ A T ρ s vs, Ftele ce_ass κ A :: T in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ vs ->
    exists a vs', vs = ⇑! a s :: vs' /\ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a /\
      Ftele T in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ⦂ entry_type_closure A ρ ⍮ S s ↘ vs'.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

The type of a view j of a group at uniform parameters ups: the container's member's at the view's instance cups, against it at uniform parameters cs related to cups, at non-uniform parameters related at the view: related types (the view's relation is the container's, nr_from). The premise Hend of shape_type_link.
Lemma view_end_type : forall VP, valid_groups VP -> forall pq G, VP pq G ->
    forall ups, per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams G)) nil nil ups ups -> List.length ups = ind_nu G ->
    forall j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq cups cs bs bs', ind_member G j = Some Mj -> im_head Mj = mh_view qc kc Is vm ->
      ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some Dq -> ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env G ups ↘ cups ->
      per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) nil nil cups cs ->
      nparams_tele_rel G (canon_nparams_rel G ups) j bs bs' ->
      exists (i : universe_index) R, DF d_ind qc kc (cups ++ bs) ≈ d_ind qc kc (cs ++ bs') ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R.
Proof.
  intros VP HP pq G HPG ups Hgu Hu j Mj qc kc Is vm Dq cups cs bs bs' HMj Hh Hq Ecups Hcs Hbs.
  pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP pq G HPG) as Hg.
  pose proof (containers_valid_of_groups VP HP pq G HPG) as Hcv.
  pose proof (Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hq) as HgQ.
  destruct (decl_typed_view _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ Hg) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh) as (D2 & Mk' & Hl2 & HMk' & Hkd & HIl & _ & Hvm & _ & _).
  rewrite Hq in Hl2; injection Hl2 as <-.
  assert (Hhd : exists pm, im_head Mk' = mh_decl pm).
  { pose proof (proj2 (decl_typed_order _ _ _ (valid_group_typed _ _ HgQ) _ _ HMk') Hkd) as Hd.
    unfold im_is_decl in Hd; destruct (im_head Mk'); [ eauto | discriminate | discriminate ]. }
  destruct Hhd as [pm Hhd].
  destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_values pq G Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hq _ _ Hgu Hu) as (c0 & c0' & E0 & E0' & Hcu).
  pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0 Ecups) as ->.
  pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ E0' Ecups) as ->.
  assert (Hlc : List.length cups = ind_nu Dq) by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ecups); exact HIl).
  pose proof (view_agreement_canonical_all VP pq G HP HPG ups ups Hgu Hu j _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh Hq Ecups Ecups) as Hvc.
  destruct (agree_members _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvc _ _ HMk') as (v & Mv & Hvmb).
  assert (v = j) as -> by (pose proof (view_member_v _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hv; rewrite Hvm in Hv; congruence).
  assert (Mv = Mj) as -> by (pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMv; rewrite HMj in HMv; congruence).
  unfold nparams_tele_rel in Hbs; rewrite HMj in Hbs.
  pose proof (nr_from pq G ups ups _ _ _ qc Dq cups cups _ _ _ vm Hvc kc Mk' j Mj bs bs' HMk' Hvmb Hbs) as Hbs'.
  destruct (valid_group_relate qc Dq HgQ kc Mk' pm cups cs bs bs' HMk' Hhd Hcs Hlc Hbs') as [i W].
  exists i; eexists; exact W.
Qed.

Lemma fresh_cargs_arg_inv : forall pq U r A gs ρ s vs, Fcargs ca_arg r A :: gs of pq U in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ vs ->
    exists a vs', vs = ⇑! a s :: vs' /\ ⟦ A ⟧ ρ ↘ a /\
      Fcargs gs of pq U in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↦ ⇑! a s ⦂ entry_type_closure A ρ ⍮ S s ↘ vs'.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

Lemma fresh_cargs_rec_inv : forall pq U t gs ρ s vs, Fcargs ca_rec t :: gs of pq U in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ⍮ s ↘ vs ->
    exists a vs', vs = ⇑! a s :: vs' /\ ⟦shty t of pq U ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ a /\
      Fcargs gs of pq U in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ⍮ S s ↘ vs'.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

The Domains of Two Shapes, Read Alike

The domains of the container's shape t' after its own prefix preQ of the container's telescope TsQ, at its uniform parameters ub, and of the group's t after the prefix pre' of the group's telescope Ts, at its uniform parameters u0; the group's canonical prefix pre of the member k: each defined, at arguments related at the group's relation of the domain read back alike, related to themselves at the container's, and so on for the rests after them.
At the domains' values bA (the container's, of B' after preQ) and bB (the group's, of B after pre'), at related arguments c and c': what cross_doms has of them, R of the rests t' and t after them.
#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record cross_doms_step (R : list domain -> list centry -> list domain -> list centry -> list domain -> ptyp -> ptyp -> Prop)
    (D' : ind_decl) (ub : list domain) (pre : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (preQ : list domain) (TsQ : list centry)
    (pre' : list domain) (B' B : exp) (bA bB : domain) (t' t : ptyp) (c c' : domain) : Prop :=
  mk_cross_doms_step
  {
The arguments read back alike at the domains
    cross_doms_top : Dom ⇓ bA c ≈ ⇓ bB c' ∈ per_top
    
The container's related to itself at its own domain
  ; cross_doms_canon : canon_doms_rel D' ub 0 preQ TsQ B' c c
    
The rests after them
  ; cross_doms_rest : R (pre ++ c :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B :: nil) (preQ ++ c :: nil) (TsQ ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B' :: nil)
                       (pre' ++ c' :: nil) t' t }.
Scheme All for cross_doms_step.

cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' t' t: the domains of the container's shape t' and the group's t, domain by domain, as the section describes (cross_doms_step at each).
Inductive cross_doms (D D' : ind_decl) (ub u0 : list domain) (dr : nat -> list domain -> list centry -> exp -> relation domain)
    (k : nat) : list domain -> list centry -> list domain -> list centry -> list domain -> ptyp -> ptyp -> Prop :=
At the ends, nothing
| cross_doms_self : forall pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' j' Ps' j Ps,
    cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (pt_self j' Ps') (pt_self j Ps)
At a domain on each side, relevant as shapes' domains are: related arguments read back alike, are related to themselves at the container's domain, and the rests after them
| cross_doms_pi : forall pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' B' t' B t bA bB,
    ⟦ B' ⟧ components_env D' ub TsQ preQ ↘ bA -> ⟦ B ⟧ components_env D u0 Ts pre' ↘ bB ->
    domain_kind bA = ak_relevant -> domain_kind bB = ak_relevant ->
    (forall c c', dr k pre Ts B c c' ->
       cross_doms_step (cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k) D' ub pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' B' B bA bB t' t c c') ->
    cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (pt_pi B' t') (pt_pi B t).

Lemma shape_type_pi_inv : forall pq U ρ B t a, ⟦shty pt_pi B t of pq U ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ a ->
    exists b, ⟦ B ⟧ ρ ↘ b /\ a = Πᵈ{ak_relevant} b (nil ↦ d_shfam pq U ρ B t ⦂ entry_type_none) fam_cod.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; eauto. Qed.

The types of a container's recursive argument and of the group's, related: their domains read alike. The group's at its uniform parameters u0, after the prefix ms', ws', ys'; the container's at ub after preQ.
Lemma cross_doms_fresh : forall p D, valid_group p D -> forall u0, per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D)) nil nil u0 u0 ->
    List.length u0 = ind_nu D ->
    forall v Mv c gs gs1 t gs2 ms ms' ws ws', ind_member D v = Some Mv -> ind_con Mv c = Some gs -> gs = gs1 ++ ca_rec t :: gs2 ->
      tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel D u0 v) (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) ms ms' ->
      tele_prefix_rel (canon_args_rel D u0 v ms c) (List.length (cargs_nonrec gs1)) ws ws' ->
      forall D' qc ub n kk t' preQ TsQ ys ys' a1 a2 (i : universe_index) R, kk + n = List.length (ptyp_doms t) -> ptyp_depth t' = n ->
        List.length preQ = List.length TsQ ->
        tele_prefix_rel (shape_doms_rel (canon_doms_rel D u0 v) (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) (cargs_nonrec_tele gs1) ms ws t) kk ys ys' ->
        ⟦shty t' of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D' ub TsQ preQ ↘ a1 ->
        ⟦shty ptyp_skip kk t of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮
          components_env D u0 (List.rev (im_nparams Mv) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t)) (ms' ++ ws' ++ ys')
          ↘ a2 ->
        DF a1 ≈ a2 ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R ->
        cross_doms D D' ub u0 (canon_doms_rel D u0) v (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
          (List.rev (im_nparams Mv) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t)) preQ TsQ (ms' ++ ws' ++ ys')
          t' (ptyp_skip kk t).
Proof.
  intros p D Hg u0 Hgu Hu v Mv c gs gs1 t gs2 ms ms' ws ws' HM Hc Heq Hm Hw D' qc ub.
  destruct (valid_group_doms_related p D Hg u0 u0 Hgu Hu Hgu) as [ud Hdr].
  pose proof (proj1 (tele_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hm) as (Lm & Lm' & _); rewrite List.length_rev in Lm, Lm'.
  pose proof (proj1 (tele_prefix_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hw) as (Lw & Lw' & _).
  induction n as [| n IH]; intros kk t' preQ TsQ ys ys' a1 a2 i R Hkn Hdp LQ Hy E1 E2 HR.
  - rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Hkn; subst kk; rewrite ptyp_skip_end.
    destruct t' as [j' Ps' | B' t1']; cbn in Hdp; [ constructor | lia ].
  - destruct (ptyp_skip_lt kk t ltac:(lia)) as (B & HB & Hs); rewrite Hs in E2 |- *.
    destruct t' as [j' Ps' | B' t1']; cbn in Hdp; [ lia |].
    pose proof (proj1 (tele_prefix_rel_iff _ _ _ _) Hy) as (Ly & Ly' & _).
    destruct (shape_type_pi_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ E1) as (b1 & Eb1' & ->); destruct (shape_type_pi_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ E2) as (b2 & Eb2' & ->).
    basic_invert_per_univ_elem HR.
    rename equiv_a_a' into Hab.
    destruct (Hdr v Mv ms ms' c gs gs1 t gs2 ws ws' kk B ys ys' HM Hm Hc Heq Hw HB Hy) as (d & d' & Ed & Ed' & [[Rd Hdd] _ Hrd']).
    rewrite components_env_shape_prefix, Ly in Ed by lia.
    rewrite components_env_shape_prefix, Ly' in Ed' by lia.
    assert (d' = b2) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
    pose proof (per_univ_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ Hdd (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ Hdd)) as Hd0.
    destruct (per_univ_elem_trans_any _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hdd (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ Hab)) as (Rx & Hx & _).
    assert (Hin : forall c0 c0', canon_doms_rel D u0 v (ms ++ ws ++ ys)
                                   (List.rev (im_nparams Mv) ++ cargs_nonrec_tele gs1 ++ List.firstn kk (shape_doms_tele t)) B c0 c0' ->
                                 in_rel c0 c0').
    { intros c0 c0' Hcc; apply (rel_link _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hd0 Hx Hab); exact (Hcc _ _ _ _ Ed Ed Hd0). }
    apply (cross_doms_pi _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ b1 b2 Eb1' Eb2'
             ltac:(rewrite (per_univ_elem_kind _ _ _ _ Hab); exact Hrd') Hrd'); intros c0 c0' Hcc; constructor; revert c0 c0' Hcc.
    + intros c0 c0' Hcc; exact (per_elem_then_per_top Hab (Hin _ _ Hcc)).
    + intros c0 c0' Hcc i0 R0 a a' Ea Ea' HR0.
      pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea Eb1') as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exp _ _ _ _ Ea' Eb1') as ->.
      apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HR0 Hab).
      pose proof (Hin _ _ Hcc) as Hc1.
      assert (HP : PER in_rel) by (eapply per_elem_PER; exact Hab).
      etransitivity; [ exact Hc1 | symmetry; exact Hc1 ].
    + intros c0 c0' Hcc.
      pose proof (Hin _ _ Hcc) as Hcc'.
      match goal with
      | Hcod : forall c c' (equiv_c_c' : in_rel c c'), rel_mod_eval _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          destruct (Hcod _ _ Hcc') as [y0 y0' Ex0 Ex0' HRx]
      end.
      apply fam_cod_shfam_inv in Ex0; apply fam_cod_shfam_inv in Ex0'.
      rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ ak_relevant) in Ex0 by exact LQ.
      rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ ak_relevant) in Ex0'
        by (unfold shape_doms_tele in *; rewrite !List.length_app, List.length_rev, length_cargs_nonrec_tele,
              List.length_firstn, List.length_map; lia).
      rewrite prefix_tele_snoc_dom in Ex0' by exact HB.
      rewrite prefix_tele_snoc_dom by exact HB.
      replace ((ms ++ ws ++ ys) ++ c0 :: nil) with (ms ++ ws ++ (ys ++ c0 :: nil)) by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      replace ((ms' ++ ws' ++ ys') ++ c0' :: nil) with (ms' ++ ws' ++ (ys' ++ c0' :: nil)) in Ex0' |- *
        by (rewrite <- !List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
      apply (IH (S kk) t1' (preQ ++ c0 :: nil) (TsQ ++ ce_ass ak_relevant B' :: nil) (ys ++ c0 :: nil) (ys' ++ c0' :: nil) y0 y0' i
               (out_rel c0 c0' Hcc') ltac:(lia) ltac:(unfold ptyp_depth in *; cbn in *; lia)
               ltac:(rewrite ?List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; lia)); [| exact Ex0 | exact Ex0' | exact HRx ].
      apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hy | unfold shape_doms_rel; rewrite (List.nth_error_nth _ _ _ HB); exact Hcc ].
Qed.

The arguments vsA of a container's constructor (kinds gsA) and vsB of the group's at the view (kinds gsB), after the container's side's prefix pre of the telescope Ts in the group's relation, its own preQ of TsQ in the container's (at the uniform parameters ub), and the group's side's pre' of Ts: at each argument recursive in both, neutrals on each side, the container's related to itself at its own relation, and the domains of their shapes read alike.
Inductive cross_tops (qc : qname) (D D' : ind_decl) (ub u0 : list domain)
    (dr : nat -> list domain -> list centry -> exp -> relation domain) (kQ k : nat) :
    list domain -> list centry -> list domain -> list centry -> list domain -> list carg -> list carg -> list domain -> list domain ->
    Prop :=
No argument
| cross_tops_nil : forall pre Ts preQ TsQ pre', cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' nil nil nil nil
Non-recursive in both: the arguments join the prefixes
| cross_tops_arg : forall pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' rA' A' rA A gsA gsB vA vB vsA vsB,
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k (pre ++ vA :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass rA A :: nil) (preQ ++ vA :: nil) (TsQ ++ ce_ass rA' A' :: nil)
      (pre' ++ vB :: nil) gsA gsB vsA vsB ->
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (ca_arg rA' A' :: gsA) (ca_arg rA A :: gsB) (vA :: vsA) (vB :: vsB)
Nested through: the container's argument joins its own prefix
| cross_tops_nest : forall pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' rA' A' t gsA gsB vA vB vsA vsB,
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts (preQ ++ vA :: nil) (TsQ ++ ce_ass rA' A' :: nil) pre' gsA gsB vsA vsB ->
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (ca_arg rA' A' :: gsA) (ca_rec t :: gsB) (vA :: vsA) (vB :: vsB)
Recursive in both: neutrals, the container's at its own relation, the domains read alike
| cross_tops_rec : forall pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' t' t gsA gsB vA vB vsA vsB,
    is_neut vA -> is_neut vB ->
    rec_arg_rel qc D' (admissible_index_at D' ub (canon_nparams_rel D' ub)) (canon_nparams_rel D' ub) (canon_args_rel D' ub)
      (canon_doms_rel D' ub) kQ ub ub preQ preQ TsQ t' vA vA ->
    cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' t' t ->
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' gsA gsB vsA vsB ->
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (ca_rec t' :: gsA) (ca_rec t :: gsB) (vA :: vsA) (vB :: vsB).

Lemma cross_tops_arg_inv : forall qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' rA' A' rA A gsA gsB vA vB vsA vsB,
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (ca_arg rA' A' :: gsA) (ca_arg rA A :: gsB) (vA :: vsA) (vB :: vsB) ->
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k (pre ++ vA :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass rA A :: nil) (preQ ++ vA :: nil) (TsQ ++ ce_ass rA' A' :: nil)
      (pre' ++ vB :: nil) gsA gsB vsA vsB.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma cross_tops_nest_inv : forall qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' rA' A' t gsA gsB vA vB vsA vsB,
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' (ca_arg rA' A' :: gsA) (ca_rec t :: gsB) (vA :: vsA) (vB :: vsB) ->
    cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts (preQ ++ vA :: nil) (TsQ ++ ce_ass rA' A' :: nil) pre' gsA gsB vsA vsB.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma con_args_arg_inv : forall p D okr nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts rA A gs v v' vs vs',
    con_args_rel p D okr nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts (ca_arg rA A :: gs) (v :: vs) (v' :: vs') ->
    con_args_rel p D okr nr ar dr k u u' (pre ++ v :: nil) (pre' ++ v' :: nil) (Ts ++ ce_ass rA A :: nil) gs vs vs'.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; assumption. Qed.

Lemma con_args_rec_inv : forall p D okr nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts t gs v v' vs vs',
    con_args_rel p D okr nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts (ca_rec t :: gs) (v :: vs) (v' :: vs') ->
    rec_arg_rel p D okr nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts t v v' /\ con_args_rel p D okr nr ar dr k u u' pre pre' Ts gs vs vs'.
Proof. intros * H; inversion H; subst; split; assumption. Qed.

Lemma cargs_params_length_tail : forall D g gs, cargs_params_length D (g :: gs) -> cargs_params_length D gs.
Proof. intros D g gs H gs1 t gs2 E; apply (H (g :: gs1) t gs2); rewrite E; reflexivity. Qed.

A member's type at uniform parameters X: at the reference the member has, after as many values as its own uniform parameters.
Lemma mref_ref_len : forall pq G j Mj X hd k pre, ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack pq = Some G -> ind_member G j = Some Mj ->
    List.length X = ind_nu G -> ⟦mref j of pq X ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, pre) ->
    im_ref pq j Mj = (hd, k) /\ List.length pre = im_unu G Mj.
Proof.
  intros * Hl HM HX E; unfold im_ref, im_unu.
  destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qv kv Iv vmv | qr Ir fl] eqn:Hh.
  - pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HM Hh E) as Heq; injection Heq as -> -> ->; split; [ reflexivity | exact HX ].
  - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HM Hh E) as (py & Heq & Ep); injection Heq as -> -> ->.
    split; [ reflexivity | exact (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ep) ].
  - exfalso; inversion E; subst; congruence.
Qed.

The fresh variables of a member's non-uniform parameters at uniform parameters related to themselves: related to themselves.
Lemma fresh_nparams_exist : forall pq G, valid_group pq G -> forall ups, per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams G)) nil nil ups ups ->
    List.length ups = ind_nu G -> forall j Mj s, ind_member G j = Some Mj ->
    exists ns, Ftele List.rev (im_nparams Mj) in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env G ups ⍮ s ↘ ns /\
      tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel G ups j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) ns ns.
Proof.
  intros pq G Hg ups Hgu Hu j Mj s HM.
  destruct (valid_group_canon pq G Hg ups Hgu Hu) as [CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI].
  pose proof (adm_fresh_of_uparams pq G ups _ _ _ (valid_group_ass _ _ Hg) CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI ups (valid_group_adm pq G Hg ups ups Hgu Hu Hgu))
    as Ha.
  destruct (fresh_tele_rel_ftele _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (adm_fresh_nparams _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ha _ Mj s HM)) as [nsu ns Fu Fa Lu Hua].
  rewrite ?List.app_nil_r in Fu, Fa.
  pose proof (functional_fresh_tele' _ _ _ _ _ Fu Fa) as <-.
  exists nsu; split; [ exact Fu | split; assumption ].
Qed.

A member's type at uniform parameters related to themselves is defined, at a member not a record view.
Lemma mref_exists : forall VP, valid_groups VP -> forall pq G, VP pq G ->
    forall X, per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams G)) nil nil X X -> List.length X = ind_nu G ->
    forall j Mj, ind_member G j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false -> exists r, ⟦mref j of pq X ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ r.
Proof.
  intros VP HP pq G HPG X Hgx Hx j Mj HM Hrv.
  pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP pq G HPG) as Hg.
  pose proof (containers_valid_of_groups VP HP pq G HPG) as Hcv.
  unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qc kc Is vm | qr Ir fl] eqn:Hh; [| | discriminate Hrv ].
  - eexists; eapply eval_mref_decl; [ exact (valid_group_lookup _ _ Hg) | exact HM | exact Hh ].
  - destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ Hg) _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hh) as (Dq & Mc & Hq & _).
    destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_values pq G Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hh Hq X X Hgx Hx) as (cs & _ & Ecs & _).
    eexists; eapply eval_mref_view; [ exact (valid_group_lookup _ _ Hg) | exact HM | exact Hh | exact Ecs ].
Qed.

Values of Instances of a Closed Telescope

Values ms and ms' of a closed telescope C entered over any bases at its entries' tags (env_extend_tagged), related at C ++ Γ0: related at C's telescope.
Lemma closed_tagged_tele_args : forall C Γ0 RCΓ B1 B2 ms ms', all_assumptions C -> ⊨ C -> ⊨ Γ0 ->
    EF C ++ Γ0 ≈ C ++ Γ0 ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RCΓ -> List.length ms = List.length C -> List.length ms' = List.length C ->
    RCΓ (env_extend_tagged Γ0 (List.rev C) B1 ms) (env_extend_tagged Γ0 (List.rev C) B2 ms') ->
    per_tele_args (List.rev C) nil nil ms ms'.
Proof.
  intros * HCa HC HΓ0 HRCΓ Hl Hl' H.
  destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HC) as [RC HRC].
  pose proof (proj2 (closed_app_sem _ _ HCa HC HΓ0) RC RCΓ HRC HRCΓ _ _ H) as H'.
  rewrite !env_extend_tagged_typed in H'.
  assert (HC' : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev C) ++ ⋅) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive, List.app_nil_r; exact HC).
  assert (HRC' : EF List.rev (List.rev C) ++ ⋅ ≈ List.rev (List.rev C) ++ ⋅ ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RC)
    by (rewrite List.rev_involutive, List.app_nil_r; exact HRC).
  assert (L1 : List.length (List.rev C) = List.length ms) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
  assert (L2 : List.length (List.rev C) = List.length ms') by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
  destruct (per_tele_args_of_env_extend _ _ _ _ per_ctx_env_nil_true HC' (List.Forall_rev HCa) HRC' _ _ _ _
              ltac:(rewrite tagged_entries_length by exact L1; lia) ltac:(rewrite tagged_entries_length by exact L2; lia) H')
    as [_ Hg].
  rewrite !tagged_entries_fst in Hg by assumption.
  exact (per_tele_args_base _ _ _ per_ctx_env_nil_true HC' (List.Forall_rev HCa) _ _ nil nil _ _ I I I Hg).
Qed.

Two instances of a closed telescope C of types of universes over Γ0 equal as substitutions: their values at related environments related at C's telescope.
Lemma closed_instance_tele_args : forall C Γ0 Ms Ms' RΓ0, all_assumptions C -> ⊨ C -> ⊨ Γ0 -> EF Γ0 ≈ Γ0 ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ0 ->
    (exists l, rel_params_evaluated ⋅ C l) ->
    Γ0 ⊨ˢ sb_of_list Id Ms ≈ sb_of_list Id Ms' : C ++ Γ0 -> List.length Ms = List.length C -> List.length Ms' = List.length C ->
    forall ρ ρ', RΓ0 ρ ρ' -> exists ms ms', ⟦ Ms ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ ms /\ ⟦ Ms' ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ' ↘ ms' /\
      per_tele_args (List.rev C) nil nil ms ms'.
Proof.
  intros * HCa HC HΓ0 HRΓ0 HCr Hsub Hl Hl' ρ ρ' Hρ.
  pose proof (closed_evaluated_over C Γ0 HCa HC HΓ0 HCr) as Hrel.
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_simple Hsub) as (RΓ1 & HRΓ1 & RΔ & HRΔ & Hs).
  assert (E : RΓ0 <~> RΓ1) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
  assert (HPΔ : PER RΔ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRΔ).
  destruct (Hs _ _ (proj1 (E _ _) Hρ)) as (y1 & y2 & Ey1 & Ey2 & Hy).
  assert (Hy11 : RΔ y1 y1) by (etransitivity; [ exact Hy | symmetry; exact Hy ]).
  assert (Hy22 : RΔ y2 y2) by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact Hy | exact Hy ]).
No entry of C is a proposition at the substitutions' values.
  assert (Hnp : forall y, RΔ y y -> forall x, x < List.length (List.rev C) ->
              ~ entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (List.rev (List.rev C) ++ Γ0) y x)
    by (intros y Hyy x Hx; rewrite List.rev_involutive; rewrite List.length_rev in Hx;
        exact (evaluated_entries_not_propositional _ _ _ HCa Hrel HRΔ _ _ Hyy x Hx)).
  assert (HlC : List.length (List.rev C) = List.length Ms) by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
  assert (HlC' : List.length (List.rev C) = List.length Ms') by (rewrite List.length_rev; lia).
  rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive C) in Ey1, Ey2.
  destruct (eval_sb_of_list_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HlC Ey1 (Hnp _ Hy11) (eval_sub_id _ _)) as (ms & Ems & A1).
  destruct (eval_sb_of_list_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HlC' Ey2 (Hnp _ Hy22) (eval_sub_id _ _)) as (ms' & Ems' & A2).
  exists ms, ms'; split; [ exact Ems | split; [ exact Ems' |] ].
  pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ems) as L1; pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ems') as L2.
  rewrite List.length_rev in A1, A2.
  apply (closed_tagged_tele_args C Γ0 RΔ (ctx_retag Γ0 ρ) (ctx_retag Γ0 ρ')); [ exact HCa | exact HC | exact HΓ0 | exact HRΔ | lia | lia |].
  eapply (per_ctx_env_resp_agree HRΔ); [ rewrite List.length_app; exact A1 | rewrite List.length_app; exact A2 | exact Hy ].
Qed.

Terms Vs of a closed telescope C of types of universes over Γ0, as an instance that commutes with substitutions: their values moved by σ at ρ, against their values at the value of σ, related at C's telescope.
Lemma closed_instance_moved_tele_args : forall C Γ0 Vs, all_assumptions C -> ⊨ C -> ⊨ Γ0 ->
    (exists l, rel_params_evaluated ⋅ C l) ->
    List.length Vs = List.length C ->
    Γ0 ⊨ˢ sb_of_list Id Vs ≈ sb_of_list Id Vs : C ++ Γ0 ->
    sub_link Γ0 (C ++ Γ0) (sb_of_list Id Vs) ->
    forall Γ' RΓ' σ ρ E u, EF Γ' ≈ Γ' ∈ per_ctx_env ↘ RΓ' -> Γ' ⊨ˢ σ ≈ σ : Γ0 -> RΓ' ρ ρ -> ⟦ σ : Γ0 ⟧s ρ ↘ E ->
      ⟦ Vs ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ E ↘ u ->
      exists w, ⟦ List.map (fun V => V[σ]) Vs ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ w /\ per_tele_args (List.rev C) nil nil w u.
Proof.
  intros * HCa HC HΓ0 HCr HVl Hsub Hlk * HRΓ' Hσ Hρ Hev Hu.
  pose proof (closed_evaluated_over C Γ0 HCa HC HΓ0 HCr) as Hrel.
  destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HCa HC HΓ0) as [HCΓ _].
  destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HCΓ) as [RCΓ HRCΓ].
  assert (HPCΓ : PER RCΓ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRCΓ).
  destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HΓ0) as [RΓ0 HRΓ0].
The value of σ is related to itself.
  destruct (rel_sub_under_ctx_at Hσ) as (R1 & HR1 & R2 & HR2 & Hs).
  assert (E1 : R1 <~> RΓ') by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
  assert (E2 : R2 <~> RΓ0) by (eapply per_ctx_env_right_irrel; eassumption).
  pose proof (proj1 (E2 _ _) (Hs _ _ _ _ (proj2 (E1 _ _) Hρ) Hev Hev)) as HEE.
The instance at it.
  destruct (instance_values_of_sub C Γ0 Vs RΓ0 RCΓ HCa HRΓ0 HRCΓ Hrel Hsub HVl E E HEE) as [u1 u2 Eu1 _ _ Hsu1 _].
  pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Eu1 Hu) as ->.
  destruct (Hlk _ _ HRΓ' _ _ Hσ _ HRCΓ _ _ Hρ Hev) as (e1 & Ee1 & He1).
  pose proof (He1 _ Hsu1) as H12.
The instance moved by σ, at ρ: the moved terms' values.
  assert (Ee1' : ⟦ sb_of_list σ (List.map (fun V => V[σ]) Vs) : C ++ Γ0 ⟧s ρ ↘ e1).
  { eapply eval_sub_sb_eq; [| exact Ee1 ].
    etransitivity; [ apply sb_of_list_compose_gen | apply sb_of_list_cong; intros x; reflexivity ]. }
  assert (He11 : RCΓ e1 e1) by (etransitivity; [ exact H12 | symmetry; exact H12 ]).
  assert (HlC : List.length (List.rev C) = List.length (List.map (fun V => V[σ]) Vs))
    by (rewrite List.length_rev, List.length_map; lia).
  assert (Hnp : forall x, x < List.length (List.rev C) ->
              ~ entry_propositional gc_deps gc_stack (List.rev (List.rev C) ++ Γ0) e1 x)
    by (intros x Hx; rewrite List.rev_involutive; rewrite List.length_rev in Hx;
        exact (evaluated_entries_not_propositional _ _ _ HCa Hrel HRCΓ _ _ He11 x Hx)).
  rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive C) in Ee1'.
  destruct (eval_sb_of_list_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HlC Ee1' Hnp Hev) as (w & Ew & Hag).
  exists w; split; [ exact Ew |].
  pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ew) as L1; pose proof (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Hu) as L2.
  rewrite List.length_map in L1; rewrite List.length_rev in Hag.
  apply (closed_tagged_tele_args C Γ0 RCΓ E (ctx_retag Γ0 E)); [ exact HCa | exact HC | exact HΓ0 | exact HRCΓ | lia | lia |].
  eapply (per_ctx_env_resp_agree HRCΓ); [ rewrite List.length_app; exact Hag | exact (fun _ _ => eq_refl) | exact H12 ].
Qed.

A view v of a group of a view k's container's view i', of the container D'' of i': its instance at the group's uniform parameters ups related to i''s instance at uniform parameters ub of k's container related to k's instance cups at ups (the view equations of v, valid_group_views_view_view_is).
Lemma view_view_values : forall VP, valid_groups VP -> forall pq G, VP pq G ->
    forall k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' k'' Is'' vm'' D'' Mv X vm',
      ind_member G k = Some Mk -> im_head Mk = mh_view qc k' Is vm -> ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some D' ->
      ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> im_head Mi' = mh_view q'' k'' Is'' vm'' -> ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack q'' = Some D'' ->
      List.nth_error vm i' = Some v -> ind_member G v = Some Mv -> im_head Mv = mh_view q'' k'' X vm' ->
      forall ups cups ub, per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams G)) nil nil ups ups -> List.length ups = ind_nu G ->
        ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env G ups ↘ cups -> per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) nil nil ub cups ->
        exists prea preb, ⟦ Is'' ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D' ub ↘ prea /\
          ⟦ X ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env G ups ↘ preb /\
          per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D'')) nil nil prea preb.
Proof.
  intros VP HP pq G HPG k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' k'' Is'' vm'' D'' Mv X vm' HMk Hh Hq HMi' Hh' Hq'' Hv HMv HhMv
    ups cups ub Hgu Hu Ecups Hub.
  pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP pq G HPG) as Hg.
  pose proof (containers_valid_of_groups VP HP pq G HPG) as Hcv.
  pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP pq G k Mk qc k' Is vm D' HPG HMk Hh Hq) as HVQ.
  pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' HVQ) as HgQ.
  pose proof (containers_valid_of_groups VP HP qc D' HVQ) as HcvQ.
  pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP qc D' i' Mi' q'' k'' Is'' vm'' D'' HVQ HMi' Hh' Hq'') as HVQ2.
  pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP q'' D'' HVQ2) as HgQ2.
  pose proof (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ2) as Hc2.
  pose proof (decl_closed_ass _ Hc2) as HaC; pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ2)) as HWC.
  pose proof (decl_closed_ass _ (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ)) as HaQ; pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ)) as HWQ.
  pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ (valid_group_valid _ _ Hg)) as HWG.
  destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HWC) as [RC HRC].
  assert (HPC : PER RC) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRC).
  destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HWQ) as [RQ HRQ].
  destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HWG) as [RG HRG].
The lengths of the instances.
  destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh') as (D3 & Mc3 & Hq3 & _ & _ & HlI2).
  rewrite Hq'' in Hq3; injection Hq3 as <-.
  destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ Hg) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMv HhMv) as (D4 & Mc4 & Hq4 & _ & _ & HlX).
  rewrite Hq'' in Hq4; injection Hq4 as <-.
  destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ Hg) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh) as (D5 & Mc5 & Hq5 & _ & _ & HlIs).
  rewrite Hq in Hq5; injection Hq5 as <-.
  assert (Hlc : List.length cups = ind_nu D') by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ecups); exact HlIs).
  assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
  unfold ind_nu in HlI2, HlX, Hlc, Hlb.
  set (σ := sb_of_list Id Is).
  set (E0 := decl_env G ups).
  assert (HE0 : RG E0 E0) by exact (uparams_rel_env G (valid_group_valid _ _ Hg) ups ups Hgu Hu RG HRG).
  pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams_evaluated _ (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ2)) as HCr.
  pose proof (gsub_valid (valid_group_views_view_args_gsub pq G Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq)) as Hσ.
  destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_sub_eval pq G Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMk Hh Hq ups ups Hgu Hu) as (cups0 & Ecups0 & Eσ).
  pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecups0 Ecups) as ->.
The instance Is'' is scoped over D''s uniform parameters.
  assert (HsI2 : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length (ind_uparams D'))) Is'')
    by exact (member_closed_head _ _ (decl_closed_members _ (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ HMi') _ _ _ _ Hh').
  assert (HsI2' : List.Forall (exp_scoped (List.length (ind_uparams D' ++ ind_uparams G))) Is'')
    by (eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HsI2 ]; intros I0 HI0; eapply exp_scoped_mono; [| exact HI0 ];
        rewrite List.length_app; lia).
  assert (HI2 : forall j I T, List.nth_error Is'' j = Some I -> List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D'') Id Is'') j = Some T ->
             ind_uparams D' ⊨ I : T)
    by (intros j I T HI HT; exact (valid_group_views_view_is qc D' HgQ HcvQ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh' Hq'' HI HT)).
  assert (HTex : forall j I, List.nth_error Is'' j = Some I ->
             exists T, List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D'') Id Is'') j = Some T).
  { intros j I HI; apply nth_error_lt_some'.
    rewrite length_tele_insts by exact HaC.
    assert (j < List.length Is'') by (apply List.nth_error_Some; congruence); lia. }
  
i''s instance at ub and at cups.
  destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_values qc D' HgQ HcvQ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh' Hq'' ub cups Hub ltac:(unfold ind_nu; exact Hlb))
    as (pa & ns & Epa & Ens & Hg4).
At cups, against at the value of k's instance.
  destruct (closed_inst_cross _ _ Is'' Is'' HaC HWC HWQ HCr HlI2 HlI2) as [Hsub3 _].
  { intros k0 N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-; exact (HI2 _ _ _ HN HT). }
  { exact HsI2. }
  { exact HsI2. }
  pose proof (uparams_refl_r D' (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ Hub ltac:(unfold ind_nu; exact Hlb)) as Hcc.
  assert (HWQ' : ⊨ List.rev (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) ++ ⋅) by (rewrite List.rev_involutive, List.app_nil_r; exact HWQ).
  assert (HQ3 : RQ (components_env G ups (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) cups) (decl_env D' cups)).
  { unfold components_env, decl_env.
    apply (tele_args_env_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ HRQ HWQ Hlc).
    exact (per_tele_args_base _ _ _ per_ctx_env_nil_true HWQ' (List.Forall_rev HaQ) nil nil _ _ _ _ I I I Hcc). }
  destruct (closed_instance_tele_args _ _ _ _ RQ HaC HWC HWQ HRQ HCr Hsub3 HlI2 HlI2 _ _ HQ3) as (n' & ns' & En' & Ens' & H3).
  pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ens' Ens) as ->.
At the value of k's instance, against i''s instance moved by it.
  destruct (closed_app_sem _ _ HaQ HWQ HWG) as [HWQG _].
  destruct (closed_inst_cross _ (ind_uparams D' ++ ind_uparams G) Is'' Is'' HaC HWC HWQG HCr HlI2 HlI2) as [Hsub1 Hlk1].
  { intros k0 N N' T HN HN' HT; rewrite HN in HN'; injection HN' as <-.
    exact (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _ HaQ HWQ HWG (HI2 _ _ _ HN HT)). }
  { exact HsI2'. }
  { exact HsI2'. }
  destruct (closed_instance_moved_tele_args _ _ Is'' HaC HWC HWQG HCr HlI2 Hsub1 Hlk1 _ _ σ E0 _ n' HRG Hσ HE0 Eσ En')
    as (w & Ew & H1).
i''s instance moved by k's, against v's: the view equations.
  assert (Hpt : forall k0 N N' T, List.nth_error (List.map (fun I => I[σ]) Is'') k0 = Some N -> List.nth_error X k0 = Some N' ->
             List.nth_error (tele_insts (ind_uparams D'') Id (List.map (fun I => I[σ]) Is'')) k0 = Some T ->
             ind_uparams G ⊨ N ≈ N' : T).
  { intros k0 N N' T HN HN' HT.
    apply nth_error_map_inv in HN as (I & HI & ->).
    destruct (HTex _ _ HI) as [T0 HT0].
    pose proof (tele_insts_closed_sub _ _ σ _ _ HaC (decl_closed_uparams _ Hc2) HT0) as HT0'.
    rewrite HT in HT0'; injection HT0' as ->.
    apply rel_exp_under_ctx_sym.
    exact (valid_group_views_view_view_is pq G Hg Hcv k Mk qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' v q'' k'' Is'' vm'' D'' Mv X vm' k0 N' (I[σ]) T0
             HMk Hh Hq HMi' Hh' Hq'' Hc2 Hv HMv HhMv HN' ltac:(rewrite List.nth_error_map, HI; reflexivity) HT0). }
  destruct (closed_inst_cross _ _ _ _ HaC HWC HWG HCr ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact HlI2) HlX Hpt) as [Hsub2 _].
  { apply List.Forall_map; eapply List.Forall_impl; [| exact HsI2 ]; intros I0 HI0.
    apply exp_scoped_sb_of_list; [ eapply exp_scoped_mono; [| exact HI0 ]; unfold ind_nu in HlIs; lia |].
    exact (member_closed_head _ _ (decl_closed_members _ (valid_group_closed _ _ Hg) _ _ HMk) _ _ _ _ Hh). }
  { exact (member_closed_head _ _ (decl_closed_members _ (valid_group_closed _ _ Hg) _ _ HMv) _ _ _ _ HhMv). }
  destruct (closed_instance_tele_args _ _ _ _ RG HaC HWC HWG HRG HCr Hsub2 ltac:(rewrite List.length_map; exact HlI2) HlX _ _ HE0)
    as (w' & xs & Ew' & Exs & H2).
  pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ew' Ew) as ->.
The chain, at D'''s uniform parameters.
  pose proof (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ2) as HD2.
  assert (Lpa : List.length pa = ind_nu D'') by (rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Epa); exact HlI2).
  pose proof (length_ups_tele_args D'' _ _ Hg4 Lpa) as Lns.
  exists pa, xs; split; [ exact Epa | split; [ exact Exs |] ].
  apply (uparams_trans D'' HD2 Hc2 _ _ _ Hg4 Lpa).
  apply (uparams_trans D'' HD2 Hc2 _ _ _ (uparams_sym D'' HD2 Hc2 _ _ H3 ltac:(rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ En'); exact HlI2))
           Lns).
  apply (uparams_trans D'' HD2 Hc2 _ _ _ (uparams_sym D'' HD2 Hc2 _ _ H1 ltac:(rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Ew), List.length_map; exact HlI2))
           ltac:(rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ En'); exact HlI2)).
  exact H2.
Qed.

Section CrossFresh.
  #[local] Set Default Proof Using "All".
  Variable (VP : qname -> ind_decl -> Prop) (p : qname) (D : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HP : valid_groups VP) (HPD : VP p D).
  Let Hg := valid_groups_valid VP HP p D HPD.
  Let Hcv := containers_valid_of_groups VP HP p D HPD.
  Variables (m : nat) (Mm : imember) (qc : qname) (k' : nat) (Is : list exp) (vm : list nat) (D' : ind_decl).
  Hypotheses (HMm : ind_member D m = Some Mm) (Hh : im_head Mm = mh_view qc k' Is vm)
    (Hq : ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack qc = Some D').
  Let HVQ := valid_groups_containers VP HP p D m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HPD HMm Hh Hq.
  Let HgQ := valid_groups_valid VP HP qc D' HVQ.
  Let HcvQ := containers_valid_of_groups VP HP qc D' HVQ.
  Variables (u0 cups ub : list domain).
  Hypotheses (Hgu : per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D)) nil nil u0 u0) (Hu : List.length u0 = ind_nu D)
    (Ecups : ⟦ Is ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D u0 ↘ cups)
    (Hub : per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) nil nil ub cups).
  Let nr := canon_nparams_rel D u0.
  Variables (i' : nat) (Mi' : imember) (v : nat) (Mv : imember).
  Hypotheses (HMi' : ind_member D' i' = Some Mi') (Hv : List.nth_error vm i' = Some v) (HMv : ind_member D v = Some Mv).

The fresh non-uniform parameters of the container's member at ub and of the group's at u0 are related at the group's relation.
  Record cross_params (nsA nsB : list domain) : Prop := mk_cross_params
    {
Related at the group's member
      cross_params_rel : tele_rel (nr v) (List.rev (im_nparams Mv)) nsA nsB
      
Related across at the container's member's telescope
    ; cross_params_container : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params D' Mi')) nil nil (ub ++ nsA) (cups ++ nsB)
      
The group's side related to itself at the container's
    ; cross_params_container_right : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params D' Mi')) nil nil (cups ++ nsB) (cups ++ nsB)
      
The group's side related to itself at the group's
    ; cross_params_group_right : per_tele_args (List.rev (im_params D Mv)) nil nil (u0 ++ nsB) (u0 ++ nsB) }.

  Lemma cross_fresh_nparams : forall s nsA nsB,
      Ftele List.rev (im_nparams Mi') in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D' ub ⍮ s ↘ nsA ->
      Ftele List.rev (im_nparams Mv) in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ decl_env D u0 ⍮ s ↘ nsB ->
      cross_params nsA nsB.
  Proof.
    pose proof (view_nn p D Hg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq i' Mi' v Mv HMi' Hv HMv) as Hnn.
    pose proof (valid_group_valid _ _ Hg) as HD; pose proof (valid_group_closed _ _ Hg) as Hc.
    pose proof (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) as HDQ; pose proof (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) as HcQ.
    pose proof (view_container_uparams_rel p D Hg Hcv m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Hgu Hu Ecups) as Hcc.
    pose proof (length_container_uparams p D Hg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlc.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    set (tc := List.rev (im_nparams Mi')); set (tg := List.rev (im_nparams Mv)).
The container's bases: ub and cups alone, and cups over u0 as the instance gives it.
    pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HDQ) as HUQ.
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HUQ) as [RQ HRQ].
    assert (HPQ : PER RQ) by (eapply per_env_PER; exact HRQ).
    set (Eb := decl_env D' ub); set (Ed := decl_env D' cups).
    set (Ec := components_env D u0 (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) cups); set (Eg := decl_env D u0).
    assert (HQb : RQ Eb Ed) by exact (uparams_rel_env D' HDQ ub cups Hub Hlb RQ HRQ).
    assert (HQbb : RQ Eb Eb) by (etransitivity; [ exact HQb | symmetry; exact HQb ]).
    destruct (closed_tele_base_rel (ind_uparams D') RQ Eg Eg cups (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) HUQ HRQ Hcc
                ltac:(unfold ind_nu in Hlc; exact Hlc)) as [HQc _].
    change (RQ Ed Ec) in HQc.
    assert (HQbE : RQ Eb Ec) by (etransitivity; [ exact HQb | exact HQc ]).
    assert (HQEE : RQ Ec Ec) by (etransitivity; [ symmetry; exact HQc | exact HQc ]).
    assert (HQcd : RQ Ec Ed) by (symmetry; exact HQc).
The two telescopes, equal under the view's instance.
    assert (Hac : all_assumptions tc) by exact (List.Forall_rev (member_nparams_ass D' HcQ _ _ HMi')).
    assert (Hag : all_assumptions tg) by exact (List.Forall_rev (member_nparams_ass D Hc _ _ HMv)).
    assert (HWc0 : ⊨ List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams D') by (unfold tc; rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact (valid_ind_decl_params _ HDQ _ _ HMi')).
    assert (HTc0 : forall j0 κ A, List.nth_error tc j0 = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
                     exists i : nat, List.rev (List.firstn j0 tc) ++ ind_uparams D' ⊨ A : Typeω@i)
      by (intros j0 κ A HA; exact (proj2 (valid_ind_decl_nparams _ HDQ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' HA))).
    pose proof (valid_ind_decl_uparams _ HD) as HUD.
    destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env HUD) as [RU HRU].
    pose proof (uparams_rel_env D HD _ _ Hgu Hu _ HRU) as HρU; fold Eg in HρU.
    assert (HaC0 : all_assumptions (List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams D'))
      by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ apply List.Forall_rev; exact Hac | exact (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) ]).
    assert (HWc : ⊨ List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams D' ++ ind_uparams D)
      by (rewrite List.app_assoc; exact (proj1 (closed_app_sem _ _ HaC0 HWc0 HUD))).
    assert (HTc : forall j0 κ A, List.nth_error tc j0 = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
                    exists i : nat, List.rev (List.firstn j0 tc) ++ ind_uparams D' ++ ind_uparams D ⊨ A : Typeω@i).
    { intros j0 κ A HA; destruct (HTc0 _ _ _ HA) as [i HAv].
      assert (Ha0 : all_assumptions (List.rev (List.firstn j0 tc) ++ ind_uparams D'))
        by (apply List.Forall_app; split; [ exact (all_assumptions_firstn _ _ Hac) | exact (decl_closed_ass _ HcQ) ]).
      exists i; rewrite List.app_assoc; exact (closed_app_valid _ _ _ _ _ Ha0 (rel_ctx_wf_firstn _ _ j0 HWc0) HUD HAv). }
    assert (HWg : ⊨ List.rev tg ++ ind_uparams D) by (unfold tg; rewrite List.rev_involutive; exact (valid_ind_decl_params _ HD _ _ HMv)).
    assert (HTg : forall j0 κ A, List.nth_error tg j0 = Some (ce_ass κ A) ->
                    exists i : nat, List.rev (List.firstn j0 tg) ++ ind_uparams D ⊨ A : Typeω@i)
      by (intros j0 κ A HA; exact (proj2 (valid_ind_decl_nparams _ HD _ _ _ _ _ HMv HA))).
    assert (Heq : ind_uparams D ⊨ˣ tele_sub (List.rev tg) Id ≈ tele_sub (List.rev tc) (sb_of_list Id Is)).
    { unfold tg, tc; rewrite !List.rev_involutive, tele_sub_id.
      exact (valid_group_views_view_nparams p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq HMi' Hv HMv). }
    assert (Hlen : List.length tg = List.length tc) by (unfold tg, tc; rewrite !List.length_rev, !length_im_nparams; exact Hnn).
    destruct (gsub_props (valid_group_views_view_args_gsub p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq)) as [Hτ _].
    destruct (valid_group_views_view_args_sub_eval p D Hg Hcv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq u0 u0 Hgu Hu) as (cups0 & Ecups0 & Eτ).
    pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Ecups0 Ecups) as ->; fold Eg Ec in Eτ.
    assert (HEg : ⟦ Id : ind_uparams D ⟧s Eg ↘ Eg)
      by (pose proof (eval_sub_id (Θ := gc_deps) (Ξ := gc_stack) (ind_uparams D) Eg) as H0; unfold Eg in *;
          rewrite ctx_retag_decl_env in H0 by exact Hu; exact H0).
    pose proof (tele_link_types (ind_uparams D) RU Eg HRU HρU (ind_uparams D) (ind_uparams D' ++ ind_uparams D)
                  Id (sb_of_list Id Is) Eg Ec (rel_sub_id (ex_intro _ _ HRU)) Hτ HEg Eτ tg tc Hag Hac Hlen HWg HWc
                  HTg HTc Heq) as Hlink.
A prefix of a telescope's arguments reads only its own entries.
    assert (Hfi : forall ρ (T : list centry) vs j, List.length vs = j -> env_tele ρ (List.firstn j T) vs = env_tele ρ T vs)
      by (intros ρ T vs j Hj; rewrite (env_tele_firstn _ T), Hj; reflexivity).
Step by step along the two telescopes.
    assert (Main : forall n j preA preB, j + n = List.length tg -> List.length preA = j -> List.length preB = j ->
               per_tele_args (List.firstn j tc) Eb Ec preA preB ->
               per_tele_args (List.firstn j tc) Ec Ec preB preB ->
               per_tele_args (List.firstn j tg) Eg Eg preA preB ->
               per_tele_args (List.firstn j tg) Eg Eg preB preB ->
               tele_prefix_rel (nr v) j preA preB ->
               forall s rA rB, Ftele List.skipn j tc in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_tele Eb tc preA ⍮ s ↘ rA ->
                 Ftele List.skipn j tg in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ env_tele Eg tg preB ⍮ s ↘ rB ->
                 tele_prefix_rel (nr v) (List.length tg) (preA ++ rA) (preB ++ rB) /\
                 per_tele_args tc Eb Ec (preA ++ rA) (preB ++ rB) /\
                 per_tele_args tc Ec Ec (preB ++ rB) (preB ++ rB) /\
                 per_tele_args tg Eg Eg (preB ++ rB) (preB ++ rB)).
    { induction n as [| n IH]; intros j preA preB Hjn LA LB G1 G2 G3 G4 Hpre s rA rB FA FB.
      - rewrite List.skipn_all2 in FA by (rewrite <- Hlen; lia).
        rewrite List.skipn_all2 in FB by lia.
        rewrite Nat.add_0_r in Hjn.
        rewrite List.firstn_all2 in G1, G2 by (rewrite <- Hlen; lia).
        rewrite List.firstn_all2 in G4 by lia.
        inversion FA; inversion FB; subst; rewrite !List.app_nil_r.
        split; [ exact Hpre | split; [ exact G1 | split; [ exact G2 | exact G4 ] ] ].
      - destruct (List.nth_error tc j) as [ec |] eqn:HC; [| apply List.nth_error_None in HC; lia ].
        destruct (List.nth_error tg j) as [eg |] eqn:HG; [| apply List.nth_error_None in HG; lia ].
        destruct (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) Hac ec (List.nth_error_In _ _ HC)) as (κC & C & ->).
        destruct (proj1 (List.Forall_forall _ _) Hag eg (List.nth_error_In _ _ HG)) as (κG & G & ->).
        rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ HC) in FA; rewrite (skipn_nth_cons _ _ _ HG) in FB.
        destruct (fresh_tele_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ FA) as (aA & rA0 & -> & EaA & FA'); clear FA.
        destruct (fresh_tele_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ FB) as (aB & rB0 & -> & EaB & FB'); clear FB.
        assert (HlA : List.length preA = List.length (List.rev (List.firstn j tc))) by (rewrite List.length_rev, List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (HlB : List.length preA = List.length (List.rev (List.firstn j tg))) by (rewrite List.length_rev, List.length_firstn; lia).
The container's type at ub against it at the instance.
        destruct (HTc0 _ _ _ HC) as [iC HCv].
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env (rel_ctx_wf_firstn _ _ j HWc0)) as [RC HRC].
        pose proof G1 as G1'; rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive (List.firstn j tc)) in G1'.
        pose proof (tele_args_env_rel_gen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRQ HRC (rel_ctx_wf_firstn _ _ j HWc0) HQbE HlA G1') as E1.
        rewrite List.rev_involutive, (Hfi _ _ _ _ LA), (Hfi _ _ _ _ LB) in E1.
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRC HCv _ _ E1) as (a1 & a2 & Ea1 & Ea2 & [R12 H12]).
        assert (a1 = aA) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
The container's at the instance against the group's.
        destruct (Hlink j preB κG G κC C LB HG HC G4 G2) as (iL & RL & b & a & Eb' & Ea & Hba).
        rewrite (Hfi _ _ _ _ LB) in Eb'; rewrite (Hfi _ _ _ _ LB) in Ea.
        assert (b = aB) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        assert (a2 = a) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
        destruct (per_univ_elem_trans_any _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H12 (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ Hba)) as (Rx & Hx & _).
The group's type at the two prefixes.
        destruct (HTg _ _ _ HG) as [iG HGv].
        destruct (rel_ctx_wf_per_ctx_env (rel_ctx_wf_firstn _ _ j HWg)) as [RG HRG].
        pose proof G3 as G3'; rewrite <- (List.rev_involutive (List.firstn j tg)) in G3'.
        pose proof (tele_args_env_rel_gen _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HRU HRG (rel_ctx_wf_firstn _ _ j HWg) HρU HlB G3') as E3.
        rewrite List.rev_involutive, (Hfi _ _ _ _ LA), (Hfi _ _ _ _ LB) in E3.
        destruct (rel_exp_of_typ_inversion_simple_at HRG HGv _ _ E3) as (g1 & g2 & Eg1 & Eg2 & [Rg Hg12]).
        assert (g2 = aB) as -> by (eapply functional_eval_exp; eassumption).
The fresh variables, of types other than LevelSort: the container's type is a type of its context.
        pose proof (rel_type_value_not_level_sort _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (rel_type_of_typ HCv) HRC E1 Ea1) as HnA.
        pose proof (proj1 (per_univ_elem_not_level_sort_iff _ _ _ _ Hx) HnA) as HnB.
        pose proof (fresh_var_rel _ _ _ _ s Hx HnA) as Hxx.
        assert (HRg : Rg (⇑! aA s) (⇑! aB s)) by (apply (per_univ_elem_left_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hg12 Hx); exact Hxx).
        assert (H12x : R12 (⇑! aA s) (⇑! aB s)) by (apply (per_univ_elem_right_irrel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H12 Hx); exact Hxx).
        pose proof (per_univ_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ Hba (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ Hba)) as Hbb.
        pose proof (per_univ_trans _ _ _ _ _ _ (per_univ_sym _ _ _ _ Hba) Hba) as Haa.
        pose proof (fresh_var_rel _ _ _ _ s Hbb HnB) as Hbbx.
        assert (Hnrx : nr v j preA (⇑! aA s) (⇑! aB s)).
        { unfold nr, canon_nparams_rel; rewrite (nth_ctyp_eq _ _ _ _ _ _ HMv HG).
          unfold member_nparams, components_env; rewrite HMv; fold tg; fold Eg.
          apply (per_head_left Eg1 Eg2 Hg12); exact HRg. }
        assert (HfC : List.firstn (S j) tc = List.firstn j tc ++ ce_ass κC C :: nil) by exact (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ HC).
        assert (HfG : List.firstn (S j) tg = List.firstn j tg ++ ce_ass κG G :: nil) by exact (firstn_S_nth _ _ _ HG).
        assert (LfC : List.length preA = List.length (List.firstn j tc)) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (LfC' : List.length preB = List.length (List.firstn j tc)) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (LfG : List.length preA = List.length (List.firstn j tg)) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        assert (LfG' : List.length preB = List.length (List.firstn j tg)) by (rewrite List.length_firstn; lia).
        pose proof (IH (S j) (preA ++ ⇑! aA s :: nil) (preB ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil) ltac:(lia)
                      ltac:(rewrite List.length_app; cbn; lia) ltac:(rewrite List.length_app; cbn; lia)) as IH'.
        rewrite HfC, HfG in IH'.
        replace (preA ++ ⇑! aA s :: rA0) with ((preA ++ ⇑! aA s :: nil) ++ rA0) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
        replace (preB ++ ⇑! aB s :: rB0) with ((preB ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil) ++ rB0) by (rewrite <- List.app_assoc; reflexivity).
        assert (HnC : List.nth_error tc (List.length preA) = Some (ce_ass κC C)) by (rewrite LA; exact HC).
        assert (HnG : List.nth_error tg (List.length preB) = Some (ce_ass κG G)) by (rewrite LB; exact HG).
        rewrite <- (env_tele_snoc_nth Eb _ _ _ _ (⇑! aA s) HnC) in FA'.
        rewrite <- (env_tele_snoc_nth Eg _ _ _ _ (⇑! aB s) HnG) in FB'.
        rewrite <- (Hfi _ tc _ _ LA) in EaA; rewrite <- (Hfi _ tg _ _ LA) in Eg1.
        rewrite <- (Hfi _ tc _ _ LB) in Ea; rewrite <- (Hfi _ tg _ _ LB) in EaB.
        refine (IH' _ _ _ _ _ (S s) _ _ _ _).
        + apply (per_tele_args_snoc _ _ C _ _ _ _ _ _ iC R12 LfC G1); [ econstructor; [ exact EaA | exact Ea | exact H12 ] | exact H12x ].
        + apply (per_tele_args_snoc _ _ C _ _ _ _ _ _ iL RL LfC' G2); [ econstructor; [ exact Ea | exact Ea | exact Haa ] | exact Hbbx ].
        + apply (per_tele_args_snoc _ _ G _ _ _ _ _ _ iG Rg LfG G3); [ econstructor; [ exact Eg1 | exact EaB | exact Hg12 ] | exact HRg ].
        + apply (per_tele_args_snoc _ _ G _ _ _ _ _ _ iL RL LfG' G4); [ econstructor; [ exact EaB | exact EaB | exact Hbb ] | exact Hbbx ].
        + apply tele_prefix_rel_snoc; [ exact Hpre | exact Hnrx ].
        + exact FA'.
        + exact FB'.
    }
    intros s nsA nsB FA FB.
    pose proof (Main (List.length tg) 0 nil nil eq_refl eq_refl eq_refl ltac:(constructor) ltac:(constructor) ltac:(constructor)
                  ltac:(constructor) (tele_prefix_rel_nil _) s nsA nsB) as H.
    cbn [List.skipn List.app] in H.
    destruct (H FA FB) as (Hpre & G1 & G2 & G4).
    assert (HWt : ⊨ List.rev tc ++ ind_uparams D') by exact HWc0.
    pose proof (per_tele_args_base _ _ _ HRQ HWt Hac _ _ _ _ _ _ HQbE HQbb HQcd G1) as G1'.
    pose proof (per_tele_args_base _ _ _ HRQ HWt Hac _ _ _ _ _ _ HQEE HQcd HQcd G2) as G2'.
    assert (Hub' : per_tele_args (List.rev (ind_uparams D')) nil nil ub cups) by exact Hub.
    constructor; unfold im_params; rewrite ?List.rev_app_distr.
    - apply tele_rel_of_pre; exact Hpre.
    - apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [ rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hlb | exact Hub' | exact G1' ].
    - apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [ rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hlc | exact Hcc | exact G2' ].
    - apply per_tele_args_app_intro; [ rewrite List.length_rev; exact Hu | exact Hgu | exact G4 ].
  Qed.

The Fresh Arguments of a Constructor

Of the constructor c of the container's member (kinds gsA) and of the group's (kinds gsB), after the fresh non-uniform parameters nsA and nsB: related at the group's relations (con_args_rel and its non-recursive ones), position by position. The invariant is the container's telescope between the two sides and at the group's side, and the group's telescope at its side; each type the container's variable has is related to the group's through them.
  Section CrossArgs.
    Variables (c : String.string) (gsA gsB : list carg).
    Hypotheses (HconA : ind_con Mi' c = Some gsA) (HconB : ind_con Mv c = Some gsB) (Hcorr : cargs_correspond vm gsA gsB).
    Variables (nsA nsB : list domain).
    Hypothesis (Hcp : cross_params nsA nsB).
    Hypothesis (HnsA : tele_rel (canon_nparams_rel D' ub i') (List.rev (im_nparams Mi')) nsA nsA).
    Let ar := canon_args_rel D u0.
    Let dr := canon_doms_rel D u0.

The invariant past one position, the container's variable aA and the group's aB there, at the group's type CG: the container's prefixes related across and at the group's side, the group's at its side, the two variables related at CG, and their types related.
    Record cross_position_step (gA1 : list carg) (gA : carg) (gB1 : list carg) (gB : carg) (vA1 vB1 : list domain)
        (CG : exp) (aA aB : domain) (s : nat) : Prop := mk_cross_position_step
      {
The container's prefixes related across
        container_prefix_rel : per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc D' Mi' (gA1 ++ gA :: nil) ++ im_params D' Mi')) nil nil
          (ub ++ nsA ++ vA1 ++ ⇑! aA s :: nil) (cups ++ nsB ++ vB1 ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil)
        
The group's side related to itself at the container's telescope
      ; container_right_prefix : per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx qc D' Mi' (gA1 ++ gA :: nil) ++ im_params D' Mi')) nil nil
          (cups ++ nsB ++ vB1 ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil) (cups ++ nsB ++ vB1 ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil)
        
The group's side related to itself at the group's telescope
      ; group_right_prefix : per_tele_args (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv (gB1 ++ gB :: nil) ++ im_params D Mv)) nil nil
          (u0 ++ nsB ++ vB1 ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil) (u0 ++ nsB ++ vB1 ++ ⇑! aB s :: nil)
        
The two variables related at CG
      ; fresh_heads_agree : per_head CG CG (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gB1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (u0 ++ nsB ++ vB1))
          (env_tele nil (List.rev (cargs_ctx p D Mv gB1 ++ im_params D Mv)) (u0 ++ nsB ++ vB1)) (⇑! aA s) (⇑! aB s)
        
Their types related
      ; fresh_types_related : exists (i : universe_index) R, DF aA ≈ aB ∈ per_univ_elem i ↘ R
        
The left type is not LevelSort
