The container's eliminator's uniform parameters ub, at the container's own canonical relations: what IndElim asks of an eliminator's uniform parameters (ElimViewRule has it of the container's group at its instance).
  Hypothesis (Hcups_x : elim_ups_ok qc D' ub nrQ arQ drQ ub ub).

The container's motive's entries at the end of a container's shape, as eval_ihty_self types them at ub: the shape's parameters and an element of the member there, read back (Hcups_x).
  Lemma container_self_entries_readable : forall ρ j Mj Ps bs base hd k v u u' bs' v',
      ind_member D' j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false -> im_ref qc j Mj = (hd, k) ->
      ⟦ Ps ⟧* gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρ ↘ bs -> tele_rel (nrQ j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) base bs ->
      adm_uparams D' ub nrQ arQ drQ u -> adm_uparams D' ub nrQ arQ drQ u' ->
      grp_rel qc D' ub nrQ arQ drQ j u u' base bs' v v' ->
      List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (bs ++ v :: nil)
        (List.map snd (tele_entries (decl_env D' ub) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) bs
                         ++ (v, entry_type_shape qc ub ρ (pt_self j Ps)) :: nil)).
  Proof.
    intros * HM Hrv Hr Eb Hn Hau Hau' Hi.
    pose proof Hcups_x as [_ _ Aa _ Ma _ _ Ra _ _ _ _].
    destruct (proj1 (Ma j Mj HM) Hrv) as [r Hr'].
    assert (Hcm : exists cups0, ⟦mref j of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, cups0)).
    { unfold im_ref in Hr; destruct (im_head Mj) as [pm | qv kv Iv vmv | qr Ir fl] eqn:Hhj; injection Hr as <- <-.
      - rewrite (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HM Hhj Hr') in Hr'; eexists; exact Hr'.
      - destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HM Hhj Hr') as (py & -> & _); eexists; exact Hr'.
      - unfold im_is_rview in Hrv; rewrite Hhj in Hrv; discriminate. }
    destruct Hcm as [cups0 Hcm].
    destruct HcpQ as [CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI].
    pose proof (nparams_rel_refl_r qc D' ub nrQ arQ drQ HassQ CnP CnI CaP CaI CdP CdI j Mj HM _ _ Hn) as Hbb.
    rewrite List.map_app; apply List.Forall2_app;
      [ exact (nparams_entries_readable_at_admissible_base _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HassQ Aa HM Hbb) | constructor; [| constructor ] ].
    eapply entry_readable_at_evaluated; [ apply eval_entry_type_shape; econstructor; [ exact Eb | exact Hcm ] |].
    exact (Ra _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HM Hrv Hau Hau' Hcm Hi Hn).
  Qed.

The stuck eliminators at the member j of the group, with a block, and the container's members the view takes to j.
  Definition cross_bot (j : nat) : Prop :=
    forall i' Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j -> ind_member D j = Some Mj ->
      im_is_rview Mj = false -> G j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
      Dom d_elim ρb VBb qc ub i' as1 e ≈ d_elim C1 Bks p u0 j as2 e' ∈ per_bot.

  Lemma cross_view_members : forall j' j, List.nth_error vm j' = Some j ->
      exists Mj' Mj, ind_member D' j' = Some Mj' /\ view_member p D qc D' vm j' Mj' j Mj.
  Proof. exact (XE cross_member). Qed.

The two eliminators at related neutrals of a member with a block: stuck, on each side.
  Lemma cross_neut_evals : forall i' j Mj hd k as1 as2 e e' w w' ns ns', List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = false ->
      G j w w' ns ns' (⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e) (⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e') ->
      exists r r', ⟦elim ⇑ (d_ind hd k as1) e at i' of qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ r /\
        ⟦elim ⇑ (d_ind hd k as2) e' at j of p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ r'.
  Proof.
    intros * Hvi HM Hrv Hcur.
    destruct (XE cross_neut_values _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvi HM Hrv Hcur) as (Mi' & a & a' & _ & _ & Ea & Ea' & _).
    exists (⇑ a (d_elim ρb VBb qc ub i' as1 e)), (⇑ a' (d_elim C1 Bks p u0 j as2 e')); split; [ exact Ea | exact Ea' ].
  Qed.

The container's canonical relation of a member's non-uniform parameters at ub is the group's at u0 of the member the view takes it to: at cups by the view, and ub and cups are related.
  Lemma cross_nparams_transfer : forall j' Mj' j Mj, List.nth_error vm j' = Some j -> ind_member D' j' = Some Mj' ->
      ind_member D j = Some Mj -> forall a b, tele_rel (nrQ j') (List.rev (im_nparams Mj')) a b ->
      tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) a b.
  Proof.
    intros * Hv HMj' HMj a b Hab.
    pose proof (length_container_uparams p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlcu.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    pose proof (uparams_refl_l D' (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ Hub) as Hubub.
    apply (view_nparams_transfer p D Hvg Hcv m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups u0_tele_args' u0_len' Ecups j' Mj' j Mj HMj' Hv HMj).
    exact (canon_nparams_base qc D' HgQ ub cups Hubub Hlb Hub j' Mj' HMj' a b Hab).
  Qed.

The container's paths are as many as the group's it has.
  Lemma cross_marked : forall t' t, shape_correspond vm t' t ->
      marked (List.map (leaf_in D' t') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) = List.length (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D') 0 t').
  Proof.
    intros t' t Hsc.
    rewrite <- (leaves_in_count_view p qc D D' vm Hlc HlcQ Hrs HrsQ cross_view_members (S (ptyp_mem t)) t' t 0
                  ltac:(intros; lia) Hsc).
    unfold marked, leaves_in_count; induction (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t) as [| l ls IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
    destruct (leaf_in D' t' l); cbn; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
  Qed.

The Recursive Results at Neutrals, Path by Path

The recursive results of neutral arguments vA (the container's, of its shape t', after its own prefix preQ) and vB (the group's, of t, after pre'), along the group's leaf paths: the types and the eliminators' results on each side, and results taken from either (cross_leaf_results) related as the cross relation has them.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_ih_out (k : nat) (pre : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (pre' preQ : list domain) (TsQ : list centry)
      (t' t : ptyp) (vA vB : domain) (fs : list bool) : Prop :=
    mk_cross_ih_out
    {
The container's recursive results' types
      cross_ih_tyA : list domain
      
The group's recursive results' types
    ; cross_ih_tyB : list domain
      
The container's eliminator's results
    ; cross_ih_resA : list domain
      
The group's eliminator's results
    ; cross_ih_resB : list domain
      
The container's types, its components preQ of TsQ at ub
    ; cross_ih_Ta : ⟦ihty vA of t' at qc ub under ρb AsA ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D' ub TsQ preQ ↘ cross_ih_tyA
      
The group's types, its components pre' of Ts at u0
    ; cross_ih_Tb : ⟦ihty vB of t at p u0 under C1 AsB ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D u0 Ts pre' ↘ cross_ih_tyB
      
The container's eliminator's results
    ; cross_ih_Ra : ⟦ih vA of t' under qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ cross_ih_resA
      
The group's eliminator's results
    ; cross_ih_Rb : ⟦ih vB of t under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ cross_ih_resB
      
One container type per container path
    ; cross_ih_lta : List.length cross_ih_tyA = List.length (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D') 0 t')
      
One group type per group path
    ; cross_ih_ltb : List.length cross_ih_tyB = List.length (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)
      
One container result per container path
    ; cross_ih_lra : List.length cross_ih_resA = List.length (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D') 0 t')
      
One group result per group path
    ; cross_ih_lrb : List.length cross_ih_resB = List.length (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)
      
Results taken from either are related
    ; cross_ih_rel : forall oA oB,
        cross_leaf_results (List.map (leaf_in D' t') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) fs
          cross_ih_tyA cross_ih_tyB cross_ih_resA cross_ih_resB oA oB ->
        cross_result_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts t' t vA vB oA oB }.

Of the fields xsA of a container's record view (kinds gA, after its own prefix preQ) against xsB of the group's (kinds gB), the group's types tyB and results resB given: the container's types and results, and results taken from either related as cross_fields_rel has them.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_ihs_out (k : nat) (pre : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (pre' preQ : list domain) (TsQ : list centry)
      (gA gB : list carg) (xsA xsB : list domain) (fs : list bool) (tyB resB : list domain) : Prop := mk_cross_ihs_out
    {
The container's recursive results' types
      cross_ihs_tyA : list domain
      
The container's eliminator's results
    ; cross_ihs_resA : list domain
      
The container's types, its fields' after its components preQ of TsQ at ub
    ; cross_ihs_Ta : ⟦ihtys xsA of gA at qc ub under ρb AsA ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D' ub TsQ preQ ↘ cross_ihs_tyA
      
The container's eliminator's results
    ; cross_ihs_Ra : ⟦ihs xsA of gA under qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb ↘ cross_ihs_resA
      
One container type per container path
    ; cross_ihs_lta : List.length cross_ihs_tyA = cargs_nrec D' gA
      
One container result per container path
    ; cross_ihs_lra : List.length cross_ihs_resA = cargs_nrec D' gA
      
Results taken from either are related
    ; cross_ihs_rel : forall oA oB,
        cross_leaf_results (cargs_leaf_in D D' gA gB) fs cross_ihs_tyA tyB cross_ihs_resA resB oA oB ->
        cross_fields_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts gA gB xsA xsB oA oB }.

The fields one by one, the shapes recursive in both by HQ.
  Lemma cross_fields_walk : forall (Q : ptyp -> Prop),
      (forall t' t, Q t -> forall k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ vA vB fs, shape_correspond vm t' t ->
         List.length pre' = List.length Ts -> List.length preQ = List.length TsQ ->
         rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts t vA vB ->
         rec_arg_rel qc D' (admissible_index_at D' ub nrQ) nrQ arQ drQ kQ ub ub preQ preQ TsQ t' vA vA ->
         cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' t' t -> is_neut vA -> is_neut vB ->
         cross_flags_ok cross_bot (List.map (leaf_in D' t') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) fs
           (List.map leaf_mem (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) ->
         cross_ih_out k pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ t' t vA vB fs) ->
      forall gA gB xsA xsB k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ fs tyB resB, (forall t, In (ca_rec t) gB -> Q t) -> cargs_correspond vm gA gB ->
        List.length pre' = List.length Ts -> List.length preQ = List.length TsQ ->
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts gB xsA xsB ->
        cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' gA gB xsA xsB ->
        cross_flags_ok cross_bot (cargs_leaf_in D D' gA gB) fs (cargs_mems D gB) ->
        ⟦ihtys xsB of gB at p u0 under C1 AsB ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D u0 Ts pre' ↘ tyB ->
        ⟦ihs xsB of gB under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1 ↘ resB ->
        cross_ihs_out k pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ gA gB xsA xsB fs tyB resB.
  Proof.
    intros Q HQ.
    induction gA as [| g' gA IH]; intros [| gB0 gB] xsA xsB k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ fs tyB resB HinQ Hco L' LQ Hca Ht Hfl Tb Rb;
      cbn in Hco; try contradiction; try (destruct g'; contradiction).
    - inversion Ht; subst; inversion Tb; subst; inversion Rb; subst; cbn in Hfl; inversion Hfl; subst.
      apply (mk_cross_ihs_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ nil nil); try constructor; try reflexivity.
      intros oA oB Hclr; inversion Hclr; subst; constructor.
    - assert (HinQ' : forall t0, In (ca_rec t0) gB -> Q t0) by (intros t0 Hin; apply HinQ; right; exact Hin).
      destruct g' as [rA' A' | t'], gB0 as [rA A | t]; cbn in Hco; try contradiction;
        try (match type of Hco with _ = _ /\ cargs_correspond _ _ _ => destruct Hco as [_ Hco] end).
      +
Non-recursive in both.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename Ht' into Ht0 end.
        pose proof Hca as Hca0; apply con_args_arg_inv in Hca0.
        inversion Tb; subst.
        match goal with T0 : eval_ihtys _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename T0 into Tb0 end.
        inversion Rb; subst.
        match goal with R0 : eval_ihs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename R0 into Rb0 end.
        rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ rA) in Tb0 by exact L'.
        cbn [cargs_leaf_in cargs_mems] in Hfl.
        match type of Ht0 with
        | cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?Tr ?pq ?Tq ?pr' _ _ _ _ =>
            assert (L'1 : List.length pr' = List.length Tr) by (rewrite ?List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; lia);
            assert (LQ1 : List.length pq = List.length Tq) by (rewrite ?List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; lia)
        end.
        destruct (IH gB _ _ k kQ _ _ _ _ _ fs tyB resB HinQ' Hco L'1 LQ1 Hca0 Ht0 Hfl Tb0 Rb0) as [tyA resA Ta Ra Lta Lra Hrel].
        apply (mk_cross_ihs_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ tyA resA).
        * apply eval_ihtys_arg; rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ rA') by exact LQ; exact Ta.
        * apply eval_ihs_arg; exact Ra.
        * exact Lta.
        * exact Lra.
        * intros oA oB Hclr; apply cross_fields_arg; exact (Hrel _ _ Hclr).
      +
Nested through by the group only: its eliminator's results.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename Ht' into Ht0 end.
        pose proof Hca as Hca0; apply con_args_rec_inv in Hca0 as [Hrr Hca0].
        inversion Tb; subst.
        match goal with T1 : eval_ihty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, T2 : eval_ihtys _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename T1 into Tb1; rename T2 into Tb2 end.
        inversion Rb; subst.
        match goal with R1 : eval_ih _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, R2 : eval_ihs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename R1 into Rb1; rename R2 into Rb2 end.
        cbn [cargs_leaf_in cargs_mems] in Hfl.
        assert (Lfm : List.length (List.map (fun _ => false) (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) = List.length (shape_mems D t))
          by (unfold shape_mems; rewrite !List.length_map; reflexivity).
        destruct (cross_flags_ok_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Lfm Hfl) as (fs1 & fs2 & -> & Hf1 & Hf2).
        match type of Ht0 with
        | cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?pq ?Tq _ _ _ _ _ =>
            assert (LQ1 : List.length pq = List.length Tq) by (rewrite ?List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; lia)
        end.
        destruct (IH gB _ _ k kQ _ _ _ _ _ fs2 _ _ HinQ' Hco L' LQ1 Hca0 Ht0 Hf2 Tb2 Rb2)
          as [tyA resA Ta Ra Lta Lra Hrel].
        apply (mk_cross_ihs_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ tyA resA).
        * apply eval_ihtys_arg; rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ rA') by exact LQ; exact Ta.
        * apply eval_ihs_arg; exact Ra.
        * exact Lta.
        * exact Lra.
        * intros oA oB Hclr.
          rewrite <- (List.app_nil_l tyA), <- (List.app_nil_l resA) in Hclr.
          pose proof (proj1 (cross_flags_ok_length _ _ _ _ Hf1)) as Lf1.
          pose proof (proj1 eval_ihty_length_all _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Tb1 D Hl Hlc) as LB1.
          pose proof (proj1 (proj2 eval_ih_length_all) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Rb1 D Hl Hlc) as LS1.
          destruct (cross_leaf_results_app_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hclr Lf1
                      ltac:(rewrite marked_none; reflexivity) ltac:(rewrite marked_none; reflexivity)
                      ltac:(rewrite LB1, List.length_map; reflexivity) ltac:(rewrite LS1, List.length_map; reflexivity))
            as (o11 & o12 & o21 & o22 & -> & -> & H1 & H2).
          destruct (cross_leaf_results_none _ _ _ _ _ _ H1) as [-> ->].
          cbn [List.app]; eapply cross_fields_nest; [ exact Rb1 | exact (Hrel _ _ H2) ].
      +
Recursive in both.
        destruct Hco as (Hmt & Hdp & Hco).
        pose proof (shape_correspond_of _ _ _ Hmt Hdp) as Hsc.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, HrQ' : rec_arg_rel qc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _,
                        Hd' : cross_doms _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename Ht' into Ht0; rename HrQ' into HrQ; rename Hd' into Hdoms end.
        match goal with Hn1 : is_neut ?a1, Hn2 : is_neut ?a2 |- _ => rename Hn1 into HnA; rename Hn2 into HnB end.
        pose proof Hca as Hca0; apply con_args_rec_inv in Hca0 as [Hrr Hca0].
        inversion Tb; subst.
        match goal with T1 : eval_ihty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, T2 : eval_ihtys _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename T1 into Tb1; rename T2 into Tb2 end.
        inversion Rb; subst.
        match goal with R1 : eval_ih _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, R2 : eval_ihs _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename R1 into Rb1; rename R2 into Rb2 end.
        cbn [cargs_leaf_in cargs_mems] in Hfl.
        assert (Lfm : List.length (List.map (leaf_in D' t') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) = List.length (shape_mems D t))
          by (unfold shape_mems; rewrite !List.length_map; reflexivity).
        destruct (cross_flags_ok_app _ _ _ _ _ _ Lfm Hfl) as (fs1 & fs2 & -> & Hf1 & Hf2).
        destruct (HQ t' t (HinQ t (or_introl eq_refl)) k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ _ _ fs1 Hsc L' LQ Hrr HrQ Hdoms HnA HnB Hf1)
          as [tyA1 tyB1 resA1 resB1 Ta1 Tb1' Ra1 Rb1' Lta1 Ltb1 Lra1 Lrb1 Hrel1].
        pose proof (functional_eval_ihty _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Tb1' Tb1) as <-.
        pose proof (functional_eval_ih _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Rb1' Rb1) as <-.
        destruct (IH gB _ _ k kQ _ _ _ _ _ fs2 _ _ HinQ' Hco L' LQ Hca0 Ht0 Hf2 Tb2 Rb2) as [tyA2 resA2 Ta2 Ra2 Lta2 Lra2 Hrel2].
        apply (mk_cross_ihs_out _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (tyA1 ++ tyA2) (resA1 ++ resA2)).
        * econstructor; [ exact Ta1 | exact Ta2 ].
        * econstructor; [ exact Ra1 | exact Ra2 ].
        * cbn [cargs_nrec]; rewrite List.length_app, Lta1, Lta2; reflexivity.
        * cbn [cargs_nrec]; rewrite List.length_app, Lra1, Lra2; reflexivity.
        * intros oA oB Hclr.
          pose proof (proj1 (cross_flags_ok_length _ _ _ _ Hf1)) as Lf1.
          destruct (cross_leaf_results_app_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hclr Lf1
                      ltac:(rewrite Lta1, (cross_marked _ _ Hsc); reflexivity) ltac:(rewrite Lra1, (cross_marked _ _ Hsc); reflexivity)
                      ltac:(rewrite Ltb1, List.length_map; reflexivity) ltac:(rewrite Lrb1, List.length_map; reflexivity))
            as (o11 & o12 & o21 & o22 & -> & -> & H1 & H2).
          destruct (cross_leaf_results_length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H1) as [Lo1 Lo2].
          eapply cross_fields_rec; [ | | exact (Hrel1 _ _ H1) | exact (Hrel2 _ _ H2) ].
          -- rewrite Lo1; unfold marked, leaves_in_count.
             clear; induction (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t) as [| l ls IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
             destruct (leaf_in D' t' l); cbn; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
          -- rewrite Lo2, List.length_map; reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Lemma cross_leaves : forall n t' t, (forall Mj, ind_member D (ptyp_mem t) = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mj = true -> ptyp_mem t < n) ->
      forall k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ vA vB fs, shape_correspond vm t' t ->
      List.length pre' = List.length Ts -> List.length preQ = List.length TsQ ->
      rec_arg_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts t vA vB ->
      rec_arg_rel qc D' (admissible_index_at D' ub nrQ) nrQ arQ drQ kQ ub ub preQ preQ TsQ t' vA vA ->
      cross_doms D D' ub u0 dr k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' t' t ->
      is_neut vA -> is_neut vB ->
      cross_flags_ok cross_bot (List.map (leaf_in D' t') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) fs
        (List.map leaf_mem (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) ->
      cross_ih_out k pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ t' t vA vB fs.
  Proof.
    induction n as [n IHn] using Wf_nat.lt_wf_ind.
    intros t'; induction t' as [j' Ps' | B' t1' IHt];
      intros [j Ps | B t1] Hrk k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ vA vB fs Hsc L' LQ Hrg HrQ Hd HnA HnB Hfl;
      cbn in Hsc; try contradiction.
    - destruct (cross_view_members _ _ Hsc) as (Mj' & Mj & HMj' & Hvmb).
      pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMj.
      pose proof (view_member_is_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Ervs.
      destruct (im_is_rview Mj) eqn:Hrv.
      +
Record views: their fields, at the projections.
        specialize (Hrk Mj HMj Hrv); cbn [ptyp_mem] in Hrk.
        assert (Hrv' : im_is_rview Mj' = true) by congruence.
        unfold im_is_rview in Hrv'; destruct (im_head Mj') as [| | qr Is' fl] eqn:Hh'; try discriminate Hrv'.
        destruct (view_member_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb _ _ _ Hh') as (Is0 & Hh0).
        destruct (rview_struct_con _ _ _ Hrs _ _ _ _ _ HMj Hh0) as (gsr & Hcs & Hlen).
        destruct (rview_struct_con _ _ _ HrsQ _ _ _ _ _ HMj' Hh') as (gsr' & Hcs' & Hlen').
        destruct (rview_struct_record _ _ _ HrsQ _ _ _ _ _ HMj' Hh') as [Rr HR].
        pose proof (rview_record_nodup _ _ _ _ _ _ HR) as Hnd.
        assert (HcB : ind_con Mj rview_con = Some gsr)
          by (unfold ind_con; rewrite Hcs; cbn; rewrite ?String.eqb_refl; reflexivity).
        destruct (view_member_cons' _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb rview_con gsr HcB) as (g0 & HcA & Hcorr).
        assert (g0 = gsr') as ->
          by (unfold ind_con in HcA; rewrite Hcs' in HcA; cbn in HcA; rewrite ?String.eqb_refl in HcA; injection HcA as <-;
              reflexivity).
The fields on each side, at the projections.
        pose proof Hrg as Hrg0; apply rec_arg_self_inv in Hrg0 as (bs & bs' & Eb & Eb' & _ & _ & Hi).
        pose proof HrQ as HrQ0; apply rec_arg_self_inv in HrQ0 as (bsQ & bsQ' & EbQ & EbQ' & _ & _ & HiQ).
        pose proof Hi as Hi0.

The container's flags along its own paths: those along the group's paths the container has.
  Lemma cross_container_flags : forall X t'' t' t, shape_correspond vm t' t ->
      List.map (leaf_in X t'') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D') 0 t')
      = sel_flags (List.map (leaf_in D' t') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)) (List.map (leaf_in X t'') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t)).
  Proof.
    intros X t'' t' t Hsc.
    rewrite sel_flags_map.
    assert (Hsk : forall ls, List.map (leaf_in X t'') ls = List.map (leaf_in X t'') (List.map leaf_skeleton ls))
      by (intros ls; rewrite List.map_map; apply List.map_ext; intros l; rewrite leaf_in_skeleton; reflexivity).
    rewrite (Hsk (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D') 0 t')), (Hsk (List.filter _ _)).
    rewrite (leaves_view_skeleton p qc D D' vm Hlc HlcQ Hrs HrsQ cross_view_members (S (ptyp_mem t)) t' t 0 0
               ltac:(intros; lia) Hsc); reflexivity.
  Qed.

  Lemma cross_leaf_results_all_nest : forall cs A B R S, List.length A = marked cs -> List.length R = marked cs ->
      List.length B = List.length cs -> List.length S = List.length cs ->
      cross_leaf_results cs (List.map (fun _ => false) cs) A B R S R S.
  Proof.
    induction cs as [| [|] cs IH]; intros A B R S LA LR LB LS; unfold marked in *; cbn in LA, LR, LB, LS |- *.
    - destruct A, B, R, S; cbn in *; try discriminate; constructor.
    - destruct A, B, R, S; cbn in *; try discriminate; constructor; apply IH; unfold marked; lia.
    - destruct B, S; cbn in *; try discriminate; constructor; apply IH; unfold marked; lia.
  Qed.

The Recursive Results of a Branch

The arguments vA of a container's constructor (kinds gA) and vB of the group's (kinds gB), of kinds gq in the group read Dc: the fresh recursive results on each side along the paths Dc has, the wrapped results the branches are read under, and those related as cross_fields_rel has them.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_wrapped (Dc : ind_decl) (k : nat) (pre : list domain) (Ts : list centry) (pre' preQ : list domain)
      (TsQ : list centry) (gq gA gB : list carg) (vA vB : list domain) (s2 : nat) : Prop := mk_cross_wrapped
    {
The container's fresh recursive results
      cross_wrapped_ihsA : list domain
      
The group's fresh recursive results
    ; cross_wrapped_ihsB : list domain
      
The container's wrapped results
    ; cross_wrapped_wA : list domain
      
The group's wrapped results
    ; cross_wrapped_wB : list domain
      
The container's fresh results
    ; cross_wrapped_fresh_a : Fihs vA at gq gA of Dc under ρb AsA at qc ub in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D' ub TsQ preQ
        ⍮ s2 ↘ cross_wrapped_ihsA
      
The group's fresh results
    ; cross_wrapped_fresh_b : Fihs vB at gq gB of Dc under C1 AsB at p u0 in gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ components_env D u0 Ts pre'
        ⍮ s2 ↘ cross_wrapped_ihsB
      
As many on each side
    ; cross_wrapped_len : List.length cross_wrapped_ihsA = List.length cross_wrapped_ihsB
      
The container's wrapped results, from them
    ; cross_wrapped_wrap_a : ⟦wihs vA of gq gA of Dc with cross_wrapped_ihsA under qc ub VBb ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ ρb
        ↘ cross_wrapped_wA
      
The group's wrapped results, from them
    ; cross_wrapped_wrap_b : ⟦wihs vB of gq gB of Dc with cross_wrapped_ihsB under p u0 Bks ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ⍮ C1
        ↘ cross_wrapped_wB
      
The wrapped results are related
    ; cross_wrapped_related : cross_fields_rel D D' dr Rel C1 p u0 Bks k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts gA gB vA vB
        cross_wrapped_wA cross_wrapped_wB }.

The lengths of the components after one more argument, read off the relation of the rest.
  Ltac cross_tops_lengths Ht0 :=
    match type of Ht0 with
    | cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ?Tr ?pq ?Tq ?pr' _ _ _ _ =>
        assert (L'1 : List.length pr' = List.length Tr) by (rewrite ?List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; lia);
        assert (LQ1 : List.length pq = List.length Tq) by (rewrite ?List.length_app; cbn [List.length]; lia)
    end.

  Lemma cross_wrapped_results : forall (rk : nat -> nat) r, view_rank_ok gc_deps gc_stack D rk ->
      (forall j', rk j' < r -> cross_bot j') ->
      forall Dc k kQ gq gA gB vA vB pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ s2,
        cargs_same_kinds gq gA -> cargs_correspond vm gA gB -> cargs_nest_ok D Dc rk r gq gB -> cargs_leaf_mono Dc D' gq gA ->
        List.length pre' = List.length Ts -> List.length preQ = List.length TsQ ->
        con_args_rel p D (admissible_index_at D u0 nr) nr ar dr k u0 u0 pre pre' Ts gB vA vB ->
        cross_tops qc D D' ub u0 dr kQ k pre Ts preQ TsQ pre' gA gB vA vB ->
        cross_wrapped Dc k pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ gq gA gB vA vB s2.
  Proof.
    intros rk r Hrk HIH Dc k kQ.
    induction gq as [| g' gq IH]; intros [| gA0 gA] [| gB0 gB] vA vB pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ s2 Hk Hco Hno Hmo L' LQ Hca Ht;
      cbn in Hk, Hco; try contradiction;
      try (destruct g'; cbn in Hk; contradiction); try (destruct gA0; cbn in Hk, Hco; contradiction).
    - inversion Ht; subst.
      apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ nil nil nil nil); first [ reflexivity | constructor ].
    - destruct g' as [rT' T' | t''], gA0 as [rA' A' | t'], gB0 as [rA A | t]; cbn in Hk, Hco, Hno, Hmo; try contradiction;
        try (match type of Hco with _ = _ /\ cargs_correspond _ _ _ => destruct Hco as [_ Hco] end).
      +
Non-recursive throughout.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename Ht' into Ht0 end.
        inversion Hca; subst.
        match goal with Hc' : con_args_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename Hc' into Hca0 end.
        cross_tops_lengths Ht0.
        destruct (IH gA gB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ s2 Hk Hco Hno Hmo L'1 LQ1 Hca0 Ht0) as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB Li WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsA ihsB wA wB).
        * apply fresh_ihs_arg; rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ rA' _ _ LQ); exact IA.
        * apply fresh_ihs_arg; rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ rA _ _ L'); exact IB.
        * exact Li.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_arg; exact WA.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_arg; exact WB.
        * apply cross_fields_arg; exact HR.
      +
Nested through by the group only: the group's eliminator at its argument.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ => rename Ht' into Ht0 end.
        inversion Hca; subst.
        match goal with Hr' : rec_arg_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, Hc' : con_args_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename Hr' into Hrr; rename Hc' into Hca0 end.
        destruct (proj1 (proj2 (proj2 (SE self_elim_all))) _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hrr Had Had) as (ih0 & ih & _ & Ih & _).
        destruct Hno as [_ Hno].
        cross_tops_lengths Ht0.
        destruct (IH gA gB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ s2 Hk Hco Hno Hmo L'1 LQ1 Hca0 Ht0) as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB Li WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsA ihsB wA (ih ++ wB)).
        * apply fresh_ihs_arg; rewrite <- (components_env_snoc _ _ _ _ rA' _ _ LQ); exact IA.
        * apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact IB.
        * exact Li.
        * apply wrap_ihs_eval_arg; exact WA.
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_nest; [ exact Ih | exact WB ].
        * eapply cross_fields_nest; [ exact Ih | exact HR ].
      +
Nested through by both: the eliminators, at members of lower rank.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, HrQ' : rec_arg_rel qc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _,
                        Hd' : cross_doms _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename Ht' into Ht0; rename HrQ' into HrQ; rename Hd' into Hdoms end.
        match goal with Hn1 : is_neut ?a1, Hn2 : is_neut ?a2 |- _ => rename Hn1 into HnA; rename Hn2 into HnB end.
        inversion Hca; subst.
        match goal with Hr' : rec_arg_rel p _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, Hc' : con_args_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename Hr' into Hrr; rename Hc' into Hca0 end.
        destruct Hco as (Hmt & Hdp & Hco); destruct Hno as [Hlt Hno].
        pose proof (shape_correspond_of _ _ _ Hmt Hdp) as Hsc.
        set (ls := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t) in *.
        assert (Hfl : cross_flags_ok cross_bot (List.map (leaf_in D' t') ls) (List.map (fun _ => false) (List.map (leaf_in D' t') ls))
                        (List.map leaf_mem ls)).
        { rewrite List.map_map.
          apply (cross_flags_ok_of cross_bot (leaf_in D' t') (fun _ => false) ls); [ intros; discriminate |].
          intros l Hin _ _; apply HIH.
          pose proof (leaf_mem_rank p D u0 nr ar dr Hl Hass HnP HnI HaP HaI HdP HdI
                        (valid_group_adm p D Hvg u0 u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len' u0_tele_args') rk Hrk t 0 l Hin) as Hle; lia. }
        destruct (cross_leaves (S (ptyp_mem t)) t' t ltac:(intros; lia) k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ _ _ _ Hsc L' LQ Hrr HrQ Hdoms HnA HnB Hfl)
          as [tyA tyB resA resB Ta Tb Ra Rb Lta Ltb Lra Lrb Hrel].
        destruct (IH gA gB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ s2 Hk Hco Hno Hmo L' LQ Hca0 Ht0) as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB Li WA WB HR].
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ ihsA ihsB (resA ++ wA) (resB ++ wB)).
        * apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact IA.
        * apply fresh_ihs_nest; exact IB.
        * exact Li.
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_nest; [ exact Ra | exact WA ].
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_nest; [ exact Rb | exact WB ].
        * eapply cross_fields_rec; [ | exact Lrb | | exact HR ].
          -- rewrite Lra, <- (cross_marked _ _ Hsc); unfold marked, leaves_in_count, ls.
             clear; induction (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t) as [| l ls IH]; cbn; [ reflexivity |].
             destruct (leaf_in D' t' l); cbn; rewrite IH; reflexivity.
          -- apply Hrel, cross_leaf_results_all_nest;
               [ rewrite Lta; symmetry; exact (cross_marked _ _ Hsc) | rewrite Lra; symmetry; exact (cross_marked _ _ Hsc)
               | rewrite Ltb, List.length_map; reflexivity | rewrite Lrb, List.length_map; reflexivity ].
      +
Recursive throughout: the fresh recursive results along the paths the group read has.
        inversion Ht; subst.
        match goal with Ht' : cross_tops _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, HrQ' : rec_arg_rel qc _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _,
                        Hd' : cross_doms _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename Ht' into Ht0; rename HrQ' into HrQ; rename Hd' into Hdoms end.
        match goal with Hn1 : is_neut ?a1, Hn2 : is_neut ?a2 |- _ => rename Hn1 into HnA; rename Hn2 into HnB end.
        inversion Hca; subst.
        match goal with Hr' : rec_arg_rel p _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _, Hc' : con_args_rel _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ |- _ =>
          rename Hr' into Hrr; rename Hc' into Hca0 end.
        destruct Hco as (Hmt & Hdp & Hco); destruct Hno as [Hnl Hno]; destruct Hmo as [Hmono Hmo].
        pose proof (shape_correspond_of _ _ _ Hmt Hdp) as Hsc.
        set (ls := shape_leaves (rview_leaves D) 0 t) in *.
        set (fs := List.map (leaf_in Dc t'') ls).
        assert (Hfl : cross_flags_ok cross_bot (List.map (leaf_in D' t') ls) fs (List.map leaf_mem ls)).
        { apply (cross_flags_ok_of cross_bot (leaf_in D' t') (leaf_in Dc t'') ls).
          - intros l _ Hf; exact (Hmono l Hf).
          - intros l Hin _ Hf; apply HIH; exact (Hnl l Hin Hf). }
        destruct (cross_leaves (S (ptyp_mem t)) t' t ltac:(intros; lia) k kQ pre Ts pre' preQ TsQ _ _ _ Hsc L' LQ Hrr HrQ Hdoms HnA HnB Hfl)
          as [tyA tyB resA resB Ta Tb Ra Rb Lta Ltb Lra Lrb Hrel].
        destruct (fresh_cross_results _ _ _ _ Hfl tyA tyB resA resB s2
                    ltac:(rewrite Lta; symmetry; exact (cross_marked _ _ Hsc)) ltac:(rewrite Lra; symmetry; exact (cross_marked _ _ Hsc))
                    ltac:(rewrite Ltb, List.length_map; reflexivity) ltac:(rewrite Lrb, List.length_map; reflexivity))
          as [i1 i2 o1 o2 F1 F2 Li12 W1 W2 Ho].
        destruct (IH gA gB _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (List.length i1 + s2) Hk Hco Hno Hmo L' LQ Hca0 Ht0) as [ihsA ihsB wA wB IA IB Li WA WB HR].
        assert (Hfeq : sel_flags (List.map (leaf_in D' t') ls) fs = List.map (leaf_in Dc t'') (shape_leaves (rview_leaves D') 0 t'))
          by (unfold fs, ls; symmetry; exact (cross_container_flags Dc t'' t' t Hsc)).
        rewrite Hfeq in F1, W1.
        apply (mk_cross_wrapped _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ (i1 ++ ihsA) (i2 ++ ihsB) (o1 ++ wA) (o2 ++ wB)).
        * eapply fresh_ihs_rec; [ exact Hq | exact Ta | exact F1 | exact IA ].
        * eapply fresh_ihs_rec; [ exact Hl | exact Tb | exact F2 | rewrite <- Li12; exact IB ].
        * rewrite !List.length_app; lia.
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_rec; [ exact Hq | exact Ra | exact (W1 ihsA) | exact WA ].
        * eapply wrap_ihs_eval_rec; [ exact Hl | exact Rb | exact (W2 ihsB) | exact WB ].
        * destruct (cross_leaf_results_length _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Ho) as [Lo1 Lo2].
          eapply cross_fields_rec; [ | | exact (Hrel _ _ Ho) | exact HR ].
          -- rewrite Lo1; unfold ls; rewrite (cross_marked _ _ Hsc).
             rewrite <- (leaves_in_count_view p qc D D' vm Hlc HlcQ Hrs HrsQ cross_view_members (S (ptyp_mem t)) t' t 0
                           ltac:(intros; lia) Hsc); reflexivity.
          -- rewrite Lo2, List.length_map; reflexivity.
  Qed.

A Block

A block of the two stuck eliminators, the one of the member Mn of the group read Dc: the container's member a its selection sela gives, the group's member b selb gives, b the member the view takes a to, both with a block; Mn's constructors are a's, their arguments of kinds compatible with a's, the paths Dc has the container's, and nested through by b only at members of rank below r; the two members' types at a common reference.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_block_site (rk : nat -> nat) (r : nat) (Dc : ind_decl) (sela selb : option (list nat)) (n : nat) (Mn : imember)
      : Prop := mk_cross_block_site
    {
The container's member index
      cross_block_site_a : nat
      
The container's member
    ; cross_block_site_Ma : imember
      
The group's member index
    ; cross_block_site_b : nat
      
The group's member
    ; cross_block_site_Mb : imember
      
The common reference's group
    ; cross_block_site_hd : qname
      
The common reference's member
    ; cross_block_site_k : nat
      
The container side's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_prea : list domain
      
The group side's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_preb : list domain
      
sela gives a
    ; cross_block_site_src_a : elim_src sela n = cross_block_site_a
      
selb gives b
    ; cross_block_site_src_b : elim_src selb n = cross_block_site_b
      
The view takes a to b
    ; cross_block_site_in_view_map : List.nth_error vm cross_block_site_a = Some cross_block_site_b
      
a is a member of the container
    ; cross_block_site_member_a : ind_member D' cross_block_site_a = Some cross_block_site_Ma
      
a has a block
    ; cross_block_site_rv_a : im_is_rview cross_block_site_Ma = false
      
b is a member of the group
    ; cross_block_site_member_b : ind_member D cross_block_site_b = Some cross_block_site_Mb
      
b has a block
    ; cross_block_site_rv_b : im_is_rview cross_block_site_Mb = false
      
Mn has a's non-uniform parameter count
    ; cross_block_site_nn : im_nn Mn = im_nn cross_block_site_Ma
      
Mn's constructors are a's
    ; cross_block_site_names : List.map fst (im_cons Mn) = List.map fst (im_cons cross_block_site_Ma)
      
Their argument kinds are compatible with a's
    ; cross_block_site_kinds : forall c gq gA, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Ma c = Some gA -> cargs_same_kinds gq gA
      
The paths Dc has are a's
    ; cross_block_site_mono : forall c gq gA, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Ma c = Some gA ->
        cargs_leaf_mono Dc D' gq gA
      
b nests through only at members of rank below r
    ; cross_block_site_nest : forall c gq gB, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Mb c = Some gB ->
        cargs_nest_ok D Dc rk r gq gB
      
The container's paths Dc has are as many as Dc's branch binds
    ; cross_block_site_count_a : forall c gq gA, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Ma c = Some gA ->
        cargs_container_count D' Dc gq gA = cargs_nrec Dc gq
      
So are the group's
    ; cross_block_site_count_b : forall c gq gB, In (c, gq) (im_cons Mn) -> ind_con cross_block_site_Mb c = Some gB ->
        cargs_container_count D Dc gq gB = cargs_nrec Dc gq
      
a's type at ub is at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_ref_a : ⟦mref cross_block_site_a of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_block_site_hd, cross_block_site_k, cross_block_site_prea)
      
b's type at u0 is at the reference
    ; cross_block_site_ref_b : ⟦mref cross_block_site_b of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_block_site_hd, cross_block_site_k, cross_block_site_preb) }.

The scrutinee types of the two stuck eliminators' blocks, at related non-uniform parameters: the group's view's type at its instance at u0 against the container's member's at ub, related by the view's clause (view_end_type); so they read back alike.
  Lemma cross_scrutinee_types : forall i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb nsA nsB, List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
      ⟦mref i' of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, prea) -> ⟦mref j of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, preb) ->
      tele_rel (nr j) (List.rev (im_nparams Mj)) nsA nsB ->
      Dom d_ind hd k (prea ++ nsA) ≈ d_ind hd k (preb ++ nsB) ∈ per_top_typ.
  Proof.
    intros i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb nsA nsB Hvi HMi' HMj HrvI Ra Rb Hns.
    pose proof (length_container_uparams p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlcu.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    assert (Hnb : nparams_tele_rel D nr j nsB nsA) by (unfold nparams_tele_rel; rewrite HMj; exact (tsym _ _ HMj _ _ Hns)).
    destruct (group_structure_vm _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq HMi') as [jj Mjj Hvj HMjj _ Hhm].
    rewrite Hvi in Hvj; injection Hvj as <-; rewrite HMj in HMjj; injection HMjj as <-.
    unfold im_is_rview in HrvI; destruct (im_head Mi') as [pm | qv kv Iv vmv | qr Ir fl] eqn:Hh'; [| | discriminate HrvI ].
    - destruct Hhm as [vm' Hhj].
      pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HMi' Hh' Ra) as Heq; injection Heq as -> -> ->.
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hhj Rb) as (py & Heq & Epy); injection Heq as ->.
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epy Ecups) as ->.
      pose proof (uparams_sym D' (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ Hub Hlb) as Hcu.
      destruct (view_end_type VP HP p D HPD u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len' j Mj qc i' Is vm' D' cups ub nsB nsA HMj Hhj Hq Ecups Hcu Hnb)
        as (i0 & R0 & HR0).
      destruct (per_univ_elem_sym _ _ _ _ HR0) as [HR1 _].
      exact (per_univ_then_per_top_typ HR1).
    - destruct Hhm as (Is' & vm' & Hhj & _).
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HMi' Hh' Ra) as (pa & Heq & Epa); injection Heq as -> -> ->.
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hhj Rb) as (pb & Heq & Epb); injection Heq as ->.
      destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh') as (D3 & Mc3 & Hq3 & _ & _ & HlIv).
      pose proof (valid_groups_containers VP HP qc D' i' Mi' qv kv Iv vmv D3 HVQ HMi' Hh' Hq3) as HVQ3.
      pose proof (valid_groups_valid VP HP qv D3 HVQ3) as HgQ3.
      destruct (view_view_values VP HP p D HPD m Mm qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' j qv kv Iv vmv D3 Mj Is' vm'
                  HMm Hh Hq HMi' Hh' Hq3 Hvi HMj Hhj u0 cups ub u0_tele_args' u0_len' Ecups Hub) as (pa' & pb' & Epa' & Epb' & Hgp).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epa' Epa) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epb' Epb) as ->.
      pose proof (uparams_sym D3 (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ3) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ3) _ _ Hgp
                    ltac:(rewrite (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Epa); exact HlIv)) as Hcu.
      destruct (view_end_type VP HP p D HPD u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len' j Mj qv kv Is' vm' D3 pb pa nsB nsA HMj Hhj Hq3 Epb Hcu Hnb)
        as (i0 & R0 & HR0).
      destruct (per_univ_elem_sym _ _ _ _ HR0) as [HR1 _].
      exact (per_univ_then_per_top_typ HR1).
  Qed.

  Lemma cross_block_read : forall (rk : nat -> nat) r, view_rank_ok gc_deps gc_stack D rk -> (forall j', rk j' < r -> cross_bot j') ->

    pose proof (length_container_uparams p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlcu.

    pose proof (view_member_nn _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as Hnn'.

    destruct (HbB _ _ HMa HrvA) as [blA HblA]; destruct (HBks _ _ HMb HrvB) as [blB HblB].
    destruct (fresh_nparams_exist qc D' HgQ ub Hubub Hlb a Ma s HMa) as (nsA & FnsA & HnsA).
    destruct (fresh_nparams_exist p D Hvg u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len' b Mb s HMb) as (nsB & FnsB & _).

    assert (Lpa : List.length prea = im_unu D Mb) by lia.
The motives at the fresh neutral.
    assert (Hneu : G b u0 u0 nsA nsB (⇑! (d_ind hd k (prea ++ nsA)) (s + im_nn Mn)) (⇑! (d_ind hd k (preb ++ nsB)) (s + im_nn Mn))).

The motives' entries, the fresh parameters and the fresh neutral at the member's type, read back on each side.

A branch.

The branches' variables read back at the types each eliminator stores them at: the container's by its own, the group's by its own recursive results merged with the container's.

The motives at the constructors: their entries read back, the container's by its own relation of its fresh arguments.

      assert (HmA : List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (nsA ++ d_con hd k c (prea ++ nsA ++ vsA) :: nil)
                      (List.map snd (motive_entries D' Ma ub nsA (d_ind hd k (prea ++ nsA)) (d_con hd k c (prea ++ nsA ++ vsA))))).

          | constructor; [ exact (RaQ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMa HrvA AaQ AaQ Ra HGQ HnsA) | constructor ] ]. }
      pose proof HG as HG2; rewrite <- !List.app_assoc in HG2.
      assert (HmB : List.Forall2 (fun v t => entry_readable (de_term v t)) (nsB ++ d_con hd k c (preb ++ nsB ++ vsB) :: nil)
                      (List.map snd (motive_entries D Mb u0 nsB (d_ind hd k (preb ++ nsB)) (d_con hd k c (preb ++ nsB ++ vsB))))).

      destruct (Hmot_x a Ma b blA blB u0 u0 nsA nsB _ _ _ _ HMa HrvA Hvab HblA HblB HG2 HmA HmB) as (ta & tb & Ta & Tb & HT & _).

The References of the Two Sides

A container's member a with a block and the group's member b the view takes it to: their types at ub and at u0 are at a common reference.
  #[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
  Record cross_ref_pair (a b : nat) : Prop := mk_cross_ref_pair
    {
The common reference's group
      cross_ref_pair_hd : qname
      
The common reference's member
    ; cross_ref_pair_k : nat
      
a's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_prea : list domain
      
b's uniform parameters at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_preb : list domain
      
a's type at ub is at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_ref_a : ⟦mref a of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_ref_pair_hd, cross_ref_pair_k, cross_ref_pair_prea)
      
b's type at u0 is at the reference
    ; cross_ref_pair_ref_b : ⟦mref b of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (cross_ref_pair_hd, cross_ref_pair_k, cross_ref_pair_preb) }.

  Lemma cross_refs : forall a Ma b Mb, List.nth_error vm a = Some b -> ind_member D' a = Some Ma -> ind_member D b = Some Mb ->
      im_is_rview Ma = false -> cross_ref_pair a b.
  Proof.
    intros a Ma b Mb Hvab HMa HMb HrvA.
    pose proof (length_container_uparams p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlcu.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    pose proof (uparams_refl_l D' (valid_group_valid _ _ HgQ) (valid_group_closed _ _ HgQ) _ _ Hub) as Hubub.
    destruct (cross_view_members a b Hvab) as (Ma0 & Mb0 & HMa0 & Hvmb).
    rewrite HMa in HMa0; injection HMa0 as <-.
    pose proof (view_member_mem _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb) as HMb0; rewrite HMb in HMb0; injection HMb0 as <-.
    assert (HrvB : im_is_rview Mb = false) by (rewrite (view_member_is_rview _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb); exact HrvA).
    destruct (mref_exists VP HP qc D' HVQ ub Hubub Hlb a Ma HMa HrvA) as [[[hda ka] prea] Ra].
    destruct (mref_exists VP HP p D HPD u0 u0_tele_args' u0_len' b Mb HMb HrvB) as [[[hdb kb] preb] Rb].
    destruct (mref_ref_len qc D' a Ma ub hda ka prea Hq HMa Hlb Ra) as [Hra _].
    destruct (mref_ref_len p D b Mb u0 hdb kb preb Hl HMb u0_len' Rb) as [Hrb _].
    pose proof (view_member_ref _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hvmb HrvA) as Href.
    rewrite Hra, Hrb in Href; injection Href as <- <-.
    exact (mk_cross_ref_pair a b hdb kb prea preb Ra Rb).
  Qed.

The Uniform Parameters the Two Sides Read

At a declared member of the container, its own ub and k's instance cups; at a view of the container's, its instance at ub and the group's view's at u0, which the view equations relate.
  Lemma cross_uparams_read : forall i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb Dq, List.nth_error vm i' = Some j ->
      ind_member D' i' = Some Mi' -> ind_member D j = Some Mj -> im_is_rview Mi' = false ->
      ⟦mref i' of qc ub ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, prea) -> ⟦mref j of p u0 ⟧ gc_deps ⍮ gc_stack ↘ (hd, k, preb) ->
      ind_lookup gc_deps gc_stack hd = Some Dq ->
      per_top_ps (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)) prea preb.
  Proof.
    intros i' Mi' j Mj hd k prea preb Dq Hvi HMi' HMj HrvI Ra Rb HDq.
    pose proof (length_container_uparams p D Hvg m Mm qc k' Is vm D' HMm Hh Hq u0 cups Ecups) as Hlcu.
    assert (Hlb : List.length ub = ind_nu D') by (destruct (per_tele_args_length _ _ _ _ _ Hub) as [H1 _]; lia).
    destruct (group_structure_vm _ Hass _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ HMm Hh Hq HMi') as [jj Mjj Hvj HMjj _ Hhm].
    rewrite Hvi in Hvj; injection Hvj as <-; rewrite HMj in HMjj; injection HMjj as <-.
    unfold im_is_rview in HrvI; destruct (im_head Mi') as [pm | qv kv Iv vmv | qr Ir fl] eqn:Hh'; [| | discriminate HrvI ].
    - destruct Hhm as [vm' Hhj].
      pose proof (mref_decl_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HMi' Hh' Ra) as Heq; injection Heq as -> -> ->.
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hhj Rb) as (py & Heq & Epy); injection Heq as ->.
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epy Ecups) as ->.
      rewrite Hq in HDq; injection HDq as <-.
      intros s; destruct (per_tele_args_top _ _ _ _ _ Hub ltac:(rewrite List.length_rev; unfold ind_nu in Hlb; exact Hlb) s)
        as (Ms & Ms' & R1 & R2 & E); exact (mk_params_read_alike _ _ _ _ Ms Ms' R1 R2 E).
    - destruct Hhm as (Is' & vm' & Hhj & _).
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hq HMi' Hh' Ra) as (pa & Heq & Epa); injection Heq as -> -> ->.
      destruct (mref_view_inv _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hl HMj Hhj Rb) as (pb & Heq & Epb); injection Heq as ->.
      destruct (view_view_values VP HP p D HPD m Mm qc k' Is vm D' i' Mi' j qv kv Iv vmv Dq Mj Is' vm'
                  HMm Hh Hq HMi' Hh' HDq Hvi HMj Hhj u0 cups ub u0_tele_args' u0_len' Ecups Hub) as (pa' & pb' & Epa' & Epb' & Hgp).
      pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epa' Epa) as ->; pose proof (functional_eval_exps' _ _ _ _ Epb' Epb) as ->.
      destruct (group_structure_views _ (valid_group_ass _ _ HgQ) _ _ _ _ _ _ HMi' Hh') as (D3 & Mc3 & Hq3 & _ & _ & HlIv).
      rewrite HDq in Hq3; injection Hq3 as <-.
      assert (Lp : List.length pa = List.length (List.rev (ind_uparams Dq)))
        by (rewrite List.length_rev, (eval_exps_length _ _ _ Epa); exact HlIv).
      intros s; destruct (per_tele_args_top _ _ _ _ _ Hgp Lp s) as (Ms & Ms' & R1 & R2 & E);
        exact (mk_params_read_alike _ _ _ _ Ms Ms' R1 R2 E).
  Qed.

The paths of a container's member's arguments the group read has, at a declared member: all of its own.
  Lemma cargs_leaf_mono_refl : forall X gs, cargs_leaf_mono X X gs gs.
  Proof. intros X; induction gs as [| [rA A | t] gs IH]; cbn; auto. Qed.

At a view of a group Dc of the container's: those Dc has, by the view's map.
  Lemma cargs_leaf_mono_view : forall qv Dc vmv, rview_struct_ok gc_deps gc_stack Dc ->
      (forall j' j, List.nth_error vmv j' = Some j -> exists Mj' Mj, ind_member Dc j' = Some Mj' /\ view_member qc D' qv Dc vmv j' Mj' j Mj) ->
      forall gq gA, cargs_correspond vmv gq gA -> cargs_leaf_mono Dc D' gq gA.
  Proof.
    intros qv Dc vmv HrsC Hvmv.
    induction gq as [| [rA'' A'' | t''] gq IH]; intros [| [rA' A' | t'] gA] Hco; cbn in Hco |- *; try contradiction; auto.
    all: first [ exact (IH _ Hco)
               | exact (IH _ (proj2 Hco))
               | destruct Hco as (Hmt & Hdp & Hco); split; [| exact (IH _ Hco) ];
                 intros l Hin; exact (leaf_in_view_mono qc qv D' Dc vmv HrsQ HrsC Hvmv l t'' t' (shape_correspond_of _ _ _ Hmt Hdp) Hin) ].
  Qed.

The Stuck Eliminators at a Member

The group's member j the view takes the container's i' to is a view, of i''s container, at the map the agreement of the views' maps gives (view_maps_coherent): the blocks the two read for each member of the group read are the container's at its member and the group's at the member the view takes it to. Its recursive results at the paths it nests through are at members of lower rank.

The Stuck Eliminators

By strong induction on the rank.
  Theorem cross_bot_all : forall j, cross_bot j.
  Proof.
    destruct (group_structure_rank _ Hass) as [rk Hrk].
    assert (H : forall r j, rk j < r -> cross_bot j).
    { induction r as [| r IH]; intros j Hj; [ lia |].
      apply (cross_bot_rank rk Hrk j); intros j' Hj'; apply IH; lia. }
    intros j; exact (H (S (rk j)) j ltac:(lia)).
  Qed.
